ui.fmt.ifc: Imodeli egcwele ku-3D. Yijikeleze, vula noma uvale izitezi, uyinqumele ngendiza yesigaba, bese uchofoza noma yiyiphi into ukuze ubone izici nezinani zayo. Shintsha amagama, amathegi nezinani zezici, bese ulondoloza i-IFC entsha; ifayela lakho lokuqala lihlala njengalivyo.
ui.fmt.rvt.name: RVT ne-RFA
ui.fmt.rvt: Ikhadi lefayela: ukukhishwa lapho lalondolozwa khona, ulwazi lwephrojekthi, isithombe sokubuka nezifayela ezixhunyiwe. Imodeli ye-3D ngaphakathi kwe-RVT iyifomethi engachazwanga, ngakho ukuze uyibone nge-3D, khipha i-IFC kuhlelo olwayidala (Ifayela, Khipha, IFC) bese uvula i-.ifc lapha.
ui.fmt.dwg.name: DWG ne-DXF
ui.fmt.dwg: Umdwebo ngo-2D: wonke amashidi nomdwebo wemodeli, shelelisa futhi sondeza, ungqimba luvuliwe noma luvaliwe, nokuxhumana okubonakala ngokushesha. Shintsha imodeli ibe ngo-3D ukuze ujikelezele izinga lazo, ukuphakama, izindawo ze-3D, izimesh namabhulokhi. Ukubuka kokuphrinta kubonisa umdwebo omnyama ophepheni elimhlophe ngobubanzi bemigqa yawo. Imidwebo exhunyiwe nezithombe zebhulokhi yesihloko zitholakala efolda evulekile. Ifomethi ye-AutoCAD 2000 kuya kwe-2018.
ui.fmt.folder.name: Ifolda
ui.fmt.folder: Yonke imodeli esefolda yephrojekthi ngesikhathi esisodwa: amakhophi okuqinisekisa anenombolo ahlelwe nemodeli yawo, amafayela axhunyiwe ahlolwa ngefolda, nawo amafayela angaphelele abonakaliswa. Kufundwa amakhilobhaythi ambalwa kuphela ngekhadi ngalinye, ngakho idrayivu yenethiwekhi iyasebenza.
ui.noscript: Isibukeli semodeli sisebenza kusiphequluli sakho futhi sidinga i-JavaScript ne-WebGL.
ui.right.label: Izici nomtapo
ui.props.empty: Chofoza into emodelini ukuze ubone izici zayo.
set.spaces.hint: Amagumbi nezindawo ngamabhokisi abonakalayo angafihla izindonga ezisemuva kwawo, ngakho aqala efihliwe. Inkinobho ethi Izindawo isavula futhi ivale kuphela imodeli evulekile.
set.edges.label: Imiphetho lapho imodeli ivulwa
set.edges.hint: Imigqa yemiphetho inikeza ukubukeka kokudweba kodwa idla inkumbulo. "Amamodeli amancane kuphela" iyidweba emamodelini angaphansi kuka-300,000 amatriyangela. Ngaphezu kuka-1.5 million amatriyangela ihlala ivaliwe.
set.dwgstart.hint: I-3D idweba umdwebo omkhulu ngokushesha kakhulu. Amashidi, ukubuka kokuphrinta nohlu lwezinto zihlala emathebhuleni aphezu komdwebo. Umdwebo ongenalutho emodelini, noma isiphequluli esingakwazi ukubonisa i-3D, uvulwa ku-2D.
set.view.hint: Ikhamera imodeli evulwa ngayo. Lwanela ibheka imodeli yonke ukusuka ekhoneni.
set.turned.hint: Uma izindonga zesakhiwo zihamba ngokuthambekile ezinxeleni X/Y zemodeli (njengoba kufika amamodeli ahlolwe noma ayisixhumanisi esabelwanwe), "Sisesikwele nesakhiwo" siyibonisa sisesikwele: Lwanela, Phezulu, Phambili, Eceleni, ikhyubhu lokubuka nezigaba ezintsha kulandela izindonga zaso. Ikhampasi isaphawula enyakatho yemodeli.
set.panelfocus.hint: Kumapaneli ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, ukuvula isigaba esisodwa (Thola, Izinani ezipheleleyo, Ukuhlola …) kuvala ezinye ezivulekile ukuze sibe ngaphambili. Ukhiye oseceleni komcibisholo wesigaba usigcina sivulekile.
set.snap.hint: Lapho ukubeka noma ukunamathisela kuqala, ingemuva lento libambelela eduleni eliseduze. I-Tab noma inkinobho ethi Ukubamba udonga iyivala okwalesi sikhathi.
set.corner.hint: Ekhoneni lemibukwano ye-3D: ikhyubhu lokubuka okuchofozwa ohlangothini ukuze ubuke kusuka lapho, isithonjana se-X/Y/Z samanani, noma lutho. Ukubuka komdwebo ka-2D akunalo.

lib.this.intro: Yenza izinto kulo mdwebo: khetha ibhulokhi. I-DWG ayikwazi ukulondolozwa lapha, ngakho izinto zibekwa emodelini ye-IFC; vula enye ubuyele kulolu luhlu ngo-Amafayela…
lib.empty.files: Khetha ifayela ukuze wenze izinto kulo.
lib.signin.prompt: {link} ukuze ubone izinto zethimba lakho. Izinto zomphakathi azidingi ukungena.
lib.signin.member: Ungene njengo-{name}: zonke izinto zomphakathi ziyatholakala lapha. {link} ukuze ubone nezinto zethimba lakho.
lib.drag.place: Ukuze ufake into yomtapo emodelini, cindezela Beka emodelini ngaphansi kwesithombe sayo, bese uchofoza lapho iya khona.
lib.feed.intro: Ifidi ngumtapo omunye osabela izicelo ezifanayo nomtapo (/items, /items/{uuid}, /updates, /feed). Igcinwa kulesi sisiphequluli kuphela.
lib.files.intro: I-DWG, DXF, IFC, glTF/GLB, OBJ, RFA noma CSV. Ifundwa kule thebhu; akukho okulayishelwayo. Amayunithi abalulekile emidwebeni engenayo, ku-OBJ nasku-glTF.

set.author.label: Igama kuzindaba
set.author.hint: Lihamba nezindaba (BCF) ozenzayo. Uma ungene, igama le-akhawunti yakho liyasetshenziswa uma ungalibhalanga elinye lapha. Ukusetha kabusha akushintshi lutho.
set.author.account.done: Izindaba ezintsha zithwele igama le-akhawunti yakho: {name}.
set.author.cleared: Igama lisusiwe: izindaba ezintsha zicela igama.
set.assist.on: Vumela abasizi be-AI nezikripthi ukusebenzisa i-BimCraft
set.assist.hint: Umsizi kule komputha ufinyelela ku-BimCraft nge-CadCraft Studio, kuphela uma lokhu kuvuliwe. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo; ukukuvala kunqamula ngokushesha.
set.assist.read: Funda: thola izinto ufunde izakhiwo zazo
set.assist.edit: Shintsha umbono nokudweba: hlukanisa, bonisa ngaphakathi, fihla futhi uboniswe izinto; engeza amadonga, iminyango, amawindi, amaphansi, amazinga namagridi (ushintsho ngalunye luyisinyathelo osingahlehlisa)
set.assist.save: Londoloza: imodeli njengefayela elisha le-IFC (ifayela lokuqala alishintshwa ngalutho)

ml.title: Amaqoqo emephu
ml.screen_only: Izingqimba zemephu zidwetshwa phansi ngaphansi kwemodeli, kuskrini kuphela; azilondolozwa kufayela le-IFC. Uhlu lwezingqimba lugcinwa kulesi siphequluli.
ml.net.label: Izingqimba zemephu ezivela ku-inthanethi
ml.net.body: Ivaliwe kuze kube yilapho uyivula. Uma ivuliwe, i-BimCraft icela amaseva emephu owengezile izithombe zendawo ezungeze imodeli. Imodeli yakho ihlala kulesi sikhompyutha; iseva ibona indawo nekheli lakho le-inthanethi.
ml.sys.none: Umdwebo awukabi nohlelo lwamakhoordinethi, ngakho izingqimba zemephu azikwazi ukubekwa. Khetha uhlelo okungene kulo amakhoordinethi awo ngezansi.
ml.sys.search.ph: Igama noma ikhodi ye-EPSG, isib. 2277 noma Texas Central
ml.sys.place.help: Uma umdwebo usesamakhoordinethi awo, shiya lezi zingu-0. Ngaphandle kwalokho nikeza iphoyinti elilodwa lomdwebo (X, Y), lapho likhona ekhasini lemephu (E, N), nokuthi i-X yomdwebo ijikwe kangakanani kusukela empumalanga (amadigri). Iyunithi yomdwebo (Izakhiwo › Iyunithi) iguqulelwa kuleyo yohlelo.
ml.why.off: Ivaliwe: izingqimba zemephu ezivela ku-inthanethi zivaliwe (inkinobho ephezulu).

ml.bim.tool.title: Imephu noma izithombe zomoya ngaphansi kwemodeli enesikhala (amathayili, WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS, isithombe nefayela le-world)
ml.bim.nocrs: Imodeli ayinakho ukuguqulwa kwemephu (IfcMapConversion ne-IfcProjectedCRS), ngakho i-BimCraft ayazi ukuthi ikuphi emephini. Yithumele kusuka kuhlelo lokudweba ngamakhoordinethi ayo (iphoyinti lesamukelo, amakhoordinethi ahlanganyelwa) bese uyivula futhi.
ml.help.xyz: Ikheli lethayili elinezinhlamvu {{z}}, {{x}} kanye {{y}} (noma {{-y}}) lapho kufakwa khona isikali, ikholomu nomugqa; {{s}} ikhetha inhlamvu yeseva. Amathayili asemathenjini e-Web Mercator futhi aguqulelwa kuhlelo lwemephu lwemodeli.
ml.help.wmts: Ikheli le-WMTS, noma i-WMTSCapabilities.xml yalo. Iseti yematrikisi wamathayili ohlelweni lwemephu lwemodeli iyasetshenziswa uma ikhona, kungenjalo kusetshenziswe i-Web Mercator (eguqulwe).
rvt.export.help: Izilungiselelo zokuthumela i-IFC ezivulwa kahle lapha
rvt.preview.what.typed: Ukubuka kuqala kwelabhu: i-BimCraft ingazama ukufunda imodeli kule phrojekthi (elondolozwe ngo-{release}) ngelabhulari elivulekile le-rvt. Lapho lingakwazi ukufunda, izindonga, amaphansi, uphahla, izinsika nezitebhisi kufika nezimo zazo, nezinto ezifakiwe namawindi kufika njengamabhokisi; kwezinye iphrojekthi lifunda kancane kakhulu. Izici eziningi azifundwa. Akukho okulayishwa. Hlola ngokuthumela i-IFC ngaphambi kokuthembela kuyo.
rvt.preview.what.boxes: Ukubuka kuqala kwelabhu: i-BimCraft ingazama ukufunda imodeli kule phrojekthi (elondolozwe ngo-{release}) ngelabhulari elivulekile le-rvt. Kulokhu kukhululwa ifunda izindonga ngezimo zazo, kanti izinto eziningi ezinye zifunda njengamabhokisi kuphela. Akukho okulayishwa. Hlola ngokuthumela i-IFC ngaphambi kokuthembela kuyo.
rvt.preview.what.experimental: Ukubuka kuqala kwelabhu: i-BimCraft ingazama ukufunda imodeli kule phrojekthi (elondolozwe ngo-{release}) ngelabhulari elivulekile le-rvt. Ukusekelwa kwayo kwalokhu kukhululwa kuyisilingo: lindele izinto ezingekho kanye namabhokisi. Akukho okulayishwa. Hlola ngokuthumela i-IFC ngaphambi kokuthembela kuyo.
rvt.preview.old: Ukubuka kuqala kwelabhu: akukho kulolu fayela. Ilabhulari le-rvt lifunda imodeli kuphela kumaphrojekthi alondolozwe ngo-2023 noma kamuva; le yalondolozwa ngo-{release}.

frame.ui.title: Ukuhlaziya kohlaka
frame.ui.needs-ifc: Vula imodeli ye-IFC ukuze uhlaziye amabhimu, izinsika nezinqinisi zayo.
frame.ui.aid: Isisiza sokuhlaziya, hhayi ukuhlola kwekhodi: amandla, okusekela nokwehla kwezilungu njengoba zimodelwe, ngokuhlaziya kokuqala okulinganayo. Akuhloli khodi yokwakha. Unjiniyela uhlola imodeli futhi unquma ukuthi izinombolo zisho ukuthini. Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa okungezansi (insimbi, ukhonkolo) nemithwalo yokuzamazama komhlaba kuyizinyathelo ezihlukile, ezingakhethwa.
frame.ui.results-none: Akukaqalisi. Engeza imithwalo, bese ucindezela Qalisa ukuhlaziya.
frame.ui.results-stale: Imodeli ishintshe kusukela ekuhlaziyweni kokugcina: qalisa ukuhlaziya futhi.
frame.ui.summary: Amaphoyinti {nodes}, amalunga {members}, okungaziwa {dofs}, {ms} ms. Imithwalo phansi {fz} kN, okusekela phezulu {rz} kN.
frame.ui.signs: Inani elikhulu kunazo zonke ngaphakathi kwelungu ngalinye, nophawu lwalo. N > 0 kuwukucindezela kokuqina; My > 0 noMz > 0 zenza uhlangothi lwelungu olungaphansi -z kanye -y lube sekuqineni (ibhimu elipholisa ngaphansi kwesisindo linguMy > 0); ukuthambeka kulinganiswa kusuka emgqeni ohlanganisa imiphetho yelungu.
frame.ui.load-pick: Khetha amalungu amaningi noma elilodwa ukuze uwalayishe.
frame.ui.load-bad-range: Kusuka no-Kuya kufanele kube izinkapha ezingaphakathi kulungu, Kusuka ingaphambi kuKuya.
frame.ui.combos-none: Akukho zinhlanganisela: icala ngalinye libonakala lodwa.
frame.ui.combos-note: Inhlanganisela ifaka amacala ndawonye ngezilinganiso zawo (imiphumela iyengezeka: ukuhlaziywa kuyalingana). Bhala izilinganiso ekucelwa yikhodi yakho yokwakha; uhlelo alukhethi zona.
frame.ui.assume-note: Amalungu ahlaziywa ngemigqa yawo yokusebenza. Okokugcina kwebhimu nethebhu yokusika kubotshiwe, nephleyithi yokugcina iqinile. Khetha ilungu elilodwa ukuze unikeze okokugcina kwalo, noma isisekelo sensika, umthetho walo.

frame.ui.craft-title: Ukuhlaziya kohlaka lwe-{name}, njengefayela le-CraftScript: lisebenze ku-workspace ye-Script ye-PartCraft (frame3d kulabhulari).
frame.ui.craft-note: Izinyuvesi: mm, N, MPa. Yonke icala lisebenza nge-frame3d; izinhlanganisela ziyengeza imiphumela.
frame.ui.craft-done: Uhlaka luyalandwa njengefayela le-CraftScript (vula kwi-workspace ye-Script ye-PartCraft).
frame.rep.not-a-check: Isisiza sokuhlaziya, hhayi ukuhlola kwekhodi. Ikhodi yokwakha ayisetshenziswanga; unjiniyela uhlola imodeli, imithwalo nokusekela kwayo, aphinde anqume ukuthi amanani asho ukuthini.
frame.rep.method-text: Indlela yobuqinile eqondile, eyisigaba nokuqala (akukho P-delta): amakholomu ebhimu e-Euler–Bernoulli anobuqinile bokuphenduka, ukugoba ababili; ukukhululwa kokugcina ngokuncishiswa kwesimo; imithwalo esemalungwini ngemisebenzi yesimo sawo.
frame.rep.units-text: kN, kN·m, mm; ukuzungezisa ngama-milliradian. I-Z ejwayelekile iphezulu; ukudonsela kusebenza ngokuya ku-−Z.
frame.rep.signs-text: Inani elikhulu kunawo wonke ngelungu ngalinye, nesimpawu salo. N > 0 ukuqinisa; My > 0 no-Mz > 0 kwenza uhlangothi lwe-−z nolwe-−y kuqiniswe; ukuguquka kulinganiswa kusukela emugqeni phakathi kwezigcina zelungu.

day.title: Ukukhanya kwemini emagumbini
day.needs-ifc: Vula imodeli ye-IFC enamagumbi (izindawo) namawindi: ithebhu yokukhanya kwemini ilinganisela inani lokukhanya kwemini lalo lonke igumbi.
day.intro: Inani lokukhanya kwemini langaphakathi kwegumbi ngalinye elivela emawindini alo, ezindaweni zalo zangaphakathi nasesibhakabhaka ngasinye elibonwa ngamawindi. Izakhiwo ezibhekene nazo, amabhalkoni namaphuphu aphezulu athatha ingxenye yalo sibhakabhaka.
day.not: Usizo lokuklama, hhayi ukubala kokuthobela: ukulinganisa kokuqala ngefomula yenani elijwayelekile lokukhanya kwemini, hhayi isimulation, futhi hhayi ukuhlola nomthetho wokwakha noma nezinga (EN 17037, LEED kanye ne-BREEAM kudinga isimulation yokukhanya kwemini).
day.working: Ilinganisa isibhakabhaka ngalokho ngasinye ifasitela elikubonayo…
day.no-rooms: Lolu hlobo alunamagumbi (IfcSpace) anesakhiwo: engeza amagumbi kuhlelo lwakho lokwakha, noma udwebe izindonga ezivaliwe lapha: i-BimCraft yenza igumbi phakathi kwazo.
day.bands: Isiqondiso sakudala saseBrithani (BS 8206-2) sabiza igumbi elingaphansi kuka-2 % ngokuthi limnyama, u-2 kuya ku-5 % ngokuthi lithola ukukhanya kwemini ngokwengxenye, kanti u-5 % noma ngaphezulu ngokuthi lithola ukukhanya okuningi kwemini. Kuboniswa njengesiqondiso, hhayi njengokuphasa noma ukwehluleka.
day.detail.surfaces: Izindawo zangaphakathi {A} m² (iphansi {floor}, izindonga {wall}, isiling {ceiling}, ingilazi {glass}); ukubonakaliswa okuphakathi {R}.
day.detail.window: {area} m², ingilazi {glazed} m², i-engeli yesibhakabhaka θ {theta}°
day.detail.formula: Isici sokukhanya kwemini esiphakathi = T × indawo yengilazi × θ × M ÷ (izindawo zangaphakathi × (1 − R²)), siphelelisa wonke amawindi. Ingilazi ibalwa ngokubonakaliswa okungu-0.1.

day.roof.one: Ifasitela eli-1 lophahla alibalwa: le fomula yamawindi odongeni kuphela.
day.roof.other: Amawindi ophahla {n} awabalwa: le fomula yamawindi odongeni kuphela.

day.alone.one: Ifasitela elilodwa alikho eduze kwanoma yigiphi igumbi.
day.alone.other: Amawindi {n} awakho eduze kwanoma yigiphi igumbi.

day.sun.intro: Ukushisa kwelanga emawindini egumbi ngalinye ngosuku olunesibhakabhaka esicacile: ilanga eliqondile uma kungekho okulivimbayo kumodeli, isibhakabhaka, nokukhanya okuvela emhlabeni, kudlula ku-g yengilazi.
day.sun.site: Indawo: {lat}°, {lon}° (kusuka ku-IFC). Inyakatho kusukela enyakathweni yangempela yemodeli.
day.sun.no-site: Imodeli ayinayo indawo yesayithi. Thayipha ububanzi nobude, noma nika i-IfcSite ohlelweni lwakho lokwakha.
day.sun.note: Isibhakabhaka esicacile (imodeli ka-Hottel, {climate}), izikhathi ngesikhathi esijwayelekile se-UTC{tz}. I-g-value ithathwa kuzo zonke izingeli; izinhlaka nokubonakala kwengilazi ezingeli eziphansi akuthathwa.
day.sun.room: Ilanga emawindini ngalolo suku: {kwh} kWh, okuphezulu {peak} W ngesikhathi {at}.
day.sun.chart: Ukushisa kwelanga emawindini phakathi nosuku, okuphezulu {peak} W ngesikhathi {at}
day.sun.axis: Kusukela ebusuku kuya ebusuku; imigqa ngo-6:00, 12:00 no-18:00.
day.chart-off: Amashathi acinyiwe kuselula ukuze kugcine kusheshe.
day.grid.intro: Isici sokukhanya kwemini emaphoyinteni asendaweni yonke igumbi, ngendlela yokuhlukanisa okukhanyayo kwe-BRE: isibhakabhaka esibonwa ngamawindi, ukukhanya okuvela kokukhona ngaphandle, nokukhanya okubuyiselwa ngaphakathi.
day.grid.note: Okungenani amaphoyinti angu-400 egumbi ngalinye: ibanga likhula ukuze lilingane. Izinhlaka zamawindi, imiphetho kanye nokungcola kuvela kokufakwayo okungenhla.

day.grid.plan: Ipulani legumbi elinamaphoyinti {n}, isici sokukhanya kwemini esiphakathi {mean} %

comforts.hint.dormer: Bonisa izinga uphahla kulo, bese uchofoza ohlangothini lophahla lapho kuphakathi khona ubuso bangaphambili befasitela lophahla. Esc iyaphela.
comforts.dm.nohere: Akukho ophahla lapha: bonisa izinga uphahla lulo, bese uchofoza olunye nezinhlangothi zalo.

comforts.err.dormersize: Leli fasitela lophahla alikwazi ukwakhiwa: ububanzi 600 mm kuya ku-12 m, udonga lwangaphambili 300 mm kuya ku-4 m, ukuphuma kuze kube ngu-1 m.
comforts.err.shedpitch: Uphahla lwe-shed kufanele lube nokuthambeka okuncane kunophahla oluphansi kwalo.
comforts.err.dormerfit: Ifasitela lophahla alilingani nalolo hlangothi lophahla: lisuse ezigxotsheni, emifantsini nesigebengwini, noma lenze libe lincane.
comforts.err.dormerface: Beka ifasitela lophahla ohlangothini olulodwa lophahla olwenziwe ngethuluzi Lophahla.
comforts.hint.spiral: Isitebhisi esijikelezayo: chofoza maphakathi ensikeni yaso, bese uchofoza indlela esinyathelo sesiphansi esibheka ngayo. Phendula kusetha ukuthi ijikeleza kanjani uma ikhuphuka.
comforts.st.checks.ok: Ihlangabezana nezinkomba ezibekiwe zesitebhisi esijikelezayo (izinyathelo ezingaphezu kuka-9½" ziyakhuphuka, isiteshi okungenani 6¾" emgqeni wokuhamba 12" ukusuka ensikeni, ububanzi obungu-26" obuvulekile, isandla 34"–38"). Akuyona injiniyela: isikhulu sokwakha siyanquma.
comforts.err.spiral: Isitebhisi esijikelezayo sidinga insika ebanzi ngu-40–400 mm nezinyathelo ezijulile okungenani ngu-100 mm emgqeni wokuhamba.
comforts.err.curvedtrim: Izindonga ezigobile azikwazi ukunqunyelwa noma ukugoqwa okwamanje: hudula isibambelelo sokuphela kodonga olugobile kunalokho.
comforts.err.curvedframe: Izindonga ezigobile azikwazi ukufakwa uhlaka okwamanje.
comforts.ie.note: Izindonga ezine zegumbi ezibonwa ngaphakathi, zisikwe phakathi, nobubanzi balo, ukuphakama kwalo kanye namathegi eminyango, amawindi nezinto zomtapo kudonga ngalinye.

compute.set.title: Ukurenda
compute.card.title: Umshini wakho
compute.card.lede: Lokho isiphequluli sakho esivumela i-CadCraft ukuthi sikusebenzisele ukurenda. Ukwabelana ngalezi zimfanelo kusiza ukwakha izinjini ezisebenza kangcono; okwabelanwayo kuhlanganiswe futhi akuxhunyiwe ku-akhawunti yakho.
compute.card.gpu.webgpu: WebGPU: ikhadi lemifanekiso lingenza umsebenzi wokurenda.
compute.card.gpu.webgl: I-WebGL 2 kuphela: ikhadi lemifanekiso lidweba okubonwayo kanye nezithombe ezirendiwe (ikhwalithi ephezulu nge-WebGL path tracer); ukurenda ekubukweni nomugqa wokurenda kudinga i-WebGPU.
compute.card.gpu.software: Isiphequluli esisebenza esikhundleni sekhadi lemifanekiso: konke kusebenza kumprosesa.
compute.card.isolation.on: Kuvuliwe: wonke ama-core angasebenza ekhophini eyodwa yesigcawu
compute.card.isolation.off: Kuvaliwe: i-core ngayinye idinga ikhophi yayo yesigcawu, ngakho ambalwa angasebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa
compute.card.wasm.plain: Cha: kusetshenziswa indlela yokubuyisela ehamba kancane
compute.card.override: Isethwe ikheli lokuvivinya. Lo mshini wodwa wawuba: {tier}.
compute.why.webgpu-low: Ikhadi lezithombe elinendawo encane: izithombe ezinkulu ziqala emasethingini aphansi.
compute.why.integrated: Ikhadi lezithombe elakhelwe noma elesifonini: izilungiselelo ziqala phansi ukuze likhompyutha lisabele.
compute.why.small-limits: Ikhadi lezithombe livumela izigcina ezincane kuphela: izilungiselelo ziqala phansi.
compute.why.low-memory: Lesi sikhompyutha sinenkumbulo ye-4 GB noma ngaphansi kwalokho: izilungiselelo ziqala phansi.
compute.why.webgl-only: Lesi sisheshisi asinane-WebGPU, ngakho ikhadi lezithombe lisetshenziswa kuphela ukubuka okuqondile.
compute.why.webgpu-software: I-WebGPU isebenza ngesofthiwe lapha, ngakho ikhadi lezithombe lisetshenziswa kuphela ukubuka okuqondile.
compute.why.software: Kutholakale kuphela isifaki sesofthiwe esikhundleni sekhadi lezithombe.
compute.why.no-gpu: Akukho khadi lezithombe elifinyeleleka kulesi sisheshisi.

compute.bench.title: Ukuhlola isivinini sokurenda
compute.bench.lede: Ilinganisa ukuthi lesi sikhompyutha sisheshisa kangakanani umsebenzi wokurenda: wonke ama-core eprosesa, izihlahla zesimo namasistimu emisebe, nezirenda ezikhona lapha. Okusheshayo kuthatha cishe umzuzu; Okugcwele kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kusebenzisa osayizi abasetshenziswa yizinombolo ezishicilelwe.
compute.bench.copy-failed: Lesi sisheshisi asivumelanga ukukopisha. Sebenzisa Londoloza imiphumela esikhundleni salokho.
compute.bench.private: Imiphumela ihlala kulesi sikhompyutha uze uyikopishe noma uyilondoloze.
compute.lan.serve: Vumela abanye benze ukurenda kulesi sikhompyutha
compute.lan.serve-hint: Ezinye izikhompyutha kulolu xhumano lwenethiwekhi ezinekhodi yakho zingathumela lesi sikhompyutha isimo sokurenda. Akukho okudlula ku-inthanethi; isimo nezithombe ziyimfihlo phakathi kwezikhompyutha ezimbili. Akuvulekile ngokuzenzakalelayo; kusethwa kwesinye nesinye isikhompyutha.
compute.lan.wrong-tries: Amakhodi amabi amathathu ngokulandelana: kwenziwe ikhodi entsha.
compute.lan.connected-in: Enye ikhompyutha ixhunyiwe futhi ingathumela umsebenzi.
compute.lan.use-hint: Izikhompyutha kulolu xhumano lwenethiwekhi ezivumela abanye ukurenda kuzo. Xhuma ngekhodi evezwa kulelo khompyutha; ama-core ayo bese esiza ukurenda kwakho. Uma lishiya, akukho okulahlekayo.
compute.lan.none: Azikho ezitholakele kulolu xhumano lwenethiwekhi. Kwamanye amanethiwekhi ezinkampani izikhompyutha azikwazi ukubonana.
compute.lan.left: {name} uhambile. Ingxenye yomsebenzi wayo yenziwa lapha esikhundleni.

assembly.name: Igama lohlobo
assembly.order: Izungqimba zihamba kusukela ngaphandle kuya ngaphakathi. Phawula iqembu eliqhubekayo njengomgogodla. Ukuqina kwamukela iyunithi yephrojekthi noma amayunithi acacile afana no-12.7 mm.
assembly.preview: Ukubukwa kwesakhiwo; izungqimba zomgogodla zimakwe ngomugqa ophansi oluhlaza
assembly.scope: Ukulondoloza uhlobo olukhona kuzobuyekeza zonke izindonga ezilusebenzisayo. Ukuphinda kudala uhlobo olwehlukile kuyilisebenzisela izindonga ezikhethiwe.
assembly.changed: Imodeli evulekile ishintshile. Vula kabusha umhleli wesakhiwo.

materials.defaults: Ukukhetha impahla kusebenzisa ukuqina kwayo okuzenzakalelayo kwalolo zungqimba. Ungakushintsha ngemuva kwalokho. Ukuhlela umtapo akulungisi usayizi wezakhiwo ezikhona. Imibala nokugcwaliswa kuvela ekubukweni kwesakhiwo.

frame.des.aid: Izinhlolo zezingxenye zensimbi ngokwekhodi yedizayini, zezigaba ze-I. Iyisisekelo kuze kubuyekezwe unjiniyela: amandla okuqala kuphela (akukho imiphumela yesibili), akukho ukujikeleka, akukho zingxenye ezincane noma zesigaba 4, akukho oxhumano. Ayithathi indawo yokuhlola kwenjiniyela.
frame.des.pick: Khetha ikhodi yedizayini ukuze wenze izinhlanganisela zemithwalo uhlole izingxenye zensimbi.
frame.des.lengths-note: Ukubopha kuthathwa ngokuhlukaniswa okulinganayo kuwo wonke umugqa, kusukela ekuqaleni kwawo; kulawula ubude bokukhuhlana kwe-axis ebuthakathaka nobude bokuphambuka okuhlangene nokujikeleka. I-K iphindaphinda ubude bengxenye (i-axis eqinile) nobude obuboshiwe (i-axis ebuthakathaka). Lawa manani asebenza kuzo zonke izingxenye.
frame.des.na-note: Amanani ancomekayo e-EN 1990 ne-EN 1993-1-1. Shintsha lawa ukuze afanane ne-National Annex yezwe lakho; alondolozwa nephrojekthi.
frame.des.made: Izinhlanganisela ezingu-{n} zidaliwe ({clause}). Izinhlanganisela ezibhalwe ngesandla zigcinwe.
frame.des.checked: Izingxenye ezingu-{n} zihloliwe, ezingu-{bad} ziphezu komthwalo wazo, ezingu-{skip} azihlolwanga.
frame.des.no-combos: Azikho izinhlanganisela zedizayini okwamanje: cindezela Dala izinhlanganisela.
frame.des.have-combos: Izinhlanganisela ezingu-{n} zamandla nezingu-{m} zokusebenza zisetshenziswa.
frame.des.none-yet: Cindezela Hlola izingxenye ukuze ubone ukusetshenziswa kwengxenye ngayinye.
frame.des.stale: Imodeli ishintshe kusukela ekuhlolweni kokugcina. Cindezela Hlola izingxenye futhi.
frame.des.err.no-made: Akukho okuzohlanganiswa: nikeza amacala uhlobo (lufu, ophilayo, umoya …).
frame.des.err.no-combos: Dala izinhlanganisela kuqala: kuphela ezidalelwe ikhodi ezihlolwayo.
frame.des.err.no-solution: Ukuhlaziywa akuzange kusebenze; lungisa lokho kuqala.
frame.des.signs: Ukusetshenziswa kuwukudinga ngokwehlulela kumandla: u-100 % umkhawulo. Izingxenye zifakwa umbala emodelini: okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kusetshenziswa kancane, okuluhlaza cishe uhhafu, okunsundu eduze komkhawulo, okubomvu kudlula, okuthaphu akuhlolwanga.
frame.des.title: Izinhlolo zedizayini
frame.des.first-order-text: Okokuqala. Imiphumela yesibili (P-Δ, P-δ, ukukhulisa) ayifakiwe; yihlole ngaphambi kokuthembela emphumeleni.
frame.des.lengths-text: K i-axis eqinile {ky}, K i-axis ebuthakathaka {kz}, ubude obuboshiwe {lb} wengxenye, okubopha kulinganiswe kusukela ekuqaleni.
frame.des.not-built-text: Ukujikeleka, izingxenye ezincane nezesigaba 4, izigaba ezakhiwe ngewelda, izigaba ezingezona ezse-I, oxhumano, ukukhathala, umlilo, ukwakheka kokuzamazama.
frame.des.counts-text: {n} zihloliwe ({partial} kuzo ngokuphelele), {bad} ziphezu komthwalo, {skip} azihlolwanga; izinhlanganisela zamandla ezingu-{combos}.
frame.des.modulus-text: Ukuhlaziywa kusebenzise E = {model} MPa; izibalo zomthwalo zisebenzisa E = {design} MPa.

fam.ed.starter: Umndeni wokuqala. Izinguquko zakho zigcinwa kulo model kuphela; ezinye ama-model agcina okokuqala njengoba kunjalo.
fam.ed.pnote: Ubude buba ngamamillimitha kumafomula (noma bhala iyunithi: 3', 6in). Iparamitha enefomula ilandela ezinye.
fam.ed.pnote.hosted: Ubude buba ngamamillimitha kumafomula (noma bhala iyunithi: 3', 6in). Iparamitha enefomula ilandela ezinye. Udonga lunikeza {names}.
fam.ed.bnote: I-Boolean isika into yesibili ngaphandle kwoyokuqala, noma iyixhumanisa. Umphumela wayo ungasikwa noma ixhunyaniswe futhi.
fam.ed.cnote: Isixhumi yindawo lapho ipayipi noma ipayipi lomoya lixhuma khona into: iphoyinti, indlela yokuphuma kuyo, ubukhulu bayo nohlelo lwayo. Yonke into efakiwe ithola izimbobo njengama-port kwifayela le-IFC, namapayipi namapayipi omoya adwetshwe kuzo axhume kuyo.
fam.ed.fixture.note: Yisiphi lesi sisetshenziswa: indlela yaso yokukhipha ibalwa ngamayunithi esisetshenziswa lapho usayizi wemigudu ubalwa.
fam.ed.nopreview: Ukubuka kuqala akukwazi ukuboniswa lapha (akukho 3D kulesi sisesha).
fam.ed.sketch.hint: Chofoza ukuze wengeze iphoyinti ngemva kwelikhethiwe. Hudula iphoyinti ukuzeliyinyakazise (Shift: akukho ukubambelela). Chofoza isikwele esisohlangothini ukuze wengeze iphoyinti lapho, uchofoze ngo-Shift ukuze lolo hlangothi lube umnsalo. Chofoza kabili iphoyinti ukuzeliyisuse. Amaphoyinti angenanhlanhla amiswa ngamapharamitha.
fam.ed.instance.title: Isethwe kusakhi ngasinye ekubekwe kuso, hhayi ngosayizi waso
fam.ed.sym.note: Isimbonakalo i-plan edwetshela lo mndeni: imigqa, izimo nombhalo ezindaweni zomndeni (mm), nepeni, ukugcwalisa nobubanzi ngaphezulu kwesisekelo lapho ngayinye isikwa khona. Uma ukhethe "Ukusikwa kwezinto ezingqinile", i-plan iqhubeka isika izinto ezingqinile; isimbonakalo sihlala emndenini.
fam.ed.sym.none: Azikho izingxenye okwamanje: i-plan isika izinto ezingqinile. Engeza irektangela ukuze udwebe isimbonakalo sakho.
fam.ed.part.note: Faka omunye umndeni ngaphakathi kwalo (umlenze etafuleni, isibambo emnyango). Ngayinye idwetshwa endaweni nasekuphendukeni onikezayo, ngamanani onikeza amapharamitha ayo; ukugcina umndeni wangaphakathi kudweba lo futhi.
fam.ed.part.nofam: Akakho omunye umndeni okwamanje ongafakwa ngaphakathi.
fam.ed.part.title: {name} ngaphakathi
fam.ed.part.values: Amanani ayawutholayo, eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye: Igama = inani (inombolo noma isibalo samapharamitha alo mndeni; izwi noma igama lepharamitha lombhalo, impahla nokugcwalisa)
fam.ed.hot.note: Ihotspot iyiphoyinti noma umphetho oyihudulayo ukuze ushintshe ipharamitha eyodwa: ku-preview lapha, nasakhini ebekiwe ku-plan (amahotspot x no-y). Indawo yalo ibhalwa ngezibalo ezifanayo nezinto ezingqinile; ukulinyakazisa kuxazulula ipharamitha eshintshayo, ngezifomula zonke.

fam.detail.note: Konke umndeni ogcina kuzinto zawo ezingqinile nakho okudwetshwa kwisimbonakalo sawo se-plan: Okuphakeme kugcina konke; Phakathi nangaphansi kushiya izingxenye ezimakwe njengezincane kakhulu, okwenza amafayela amancane nokubuka okusheshayo. energy.intro: Ukulahleka kokushisa kwegumbi ngalinye ngasebusika, ukushisa lonke unyaka ngamasosha ezinsuku, nesikhathi sokupholisa kwasehlobo, kusuka kukho okulivalayo emodelini nakwi-U-value yakho yonke into.
energy.not: Isisiza sokuklama, hhayi ukubala okuthobela imithetho: isilinganiso esingashintshi nesikhathi nazo zonke izigaba ezikhonjisiwe, hhayi indlela ye-ISO 52016-1, hhayi ukulingisa noma isitifiketi samandla. Linganisa izinsiza ngenjiniyela.
energy.dd.note: Sebenzisa amasosha ezinsuku endaweni, ekushiseni okuyisisekelo umthombo wakho owusebenzisayo (ngokuvamile 15.5 °C noma 18 °C): isisekelo sithatha ukushisa mahhala kubantu, ukukhanya nelanga kuqaphelwe. Inombolo yokugcina yekholomu ye-CSV iyengezwa.
energy.sun.from: Ukuphakama kwelanga kuyilokho okubalwe ngaphansi kwe-Ilanga ngamawindi ({date}).
energy.sun.none: Akukho langa ekuphakameni kokupholisa okwamanje: qala ubale i-Ilanga ngamawindi, ngosuku olushisayo.
energy.total: Wonke amagumbi: ukulahleka kokushisa {heat} W, ukushisa {year} kWh ngonyaka, ukupholisa okuphezulu kwengezwe {cool} W.

energy.u.readonly: U-values zikhonjiswa lapha; ukuze ushintshe enye, yinikeze ohlelweni lwakho lokuklama (ThermalTransmittance) noma uthayiphe ukuqhuba kwezinto ngezansi.
energy.open: {a} m² yalolu hlangothi lwegumbi ahlangana nendonga, iphansi noma uphahla emodelini: aliyibalwa.
energy.room.h: Izinsuku zokulahleka kokushisa: ngaphandle {out} W/K, emhlabathini {ground} W/K, umoya {vent} W/K (0.335 × {ach} ngehora × {v} m³).
energy.room.heat: Ukulahleka kokushisa ngaphakathi: {ti} °C. Isakhiwo: {fabric} W ngaphandle: {te} °C + umhlabathi: {ground} W nga {tg} °C + umoya: {vent} W = {total} W.
energy.room.year: Ukushisa unyaka wonke: cishe {year} kWh namasosha ezinsuku {dd}.
energy.room.cool: Ukupholisa okuphezulu: isakhiwo {fabric} W + umoya {vent} W + abantu {people} W + ukukhanya {lights} W + izinsiza {equip} W + ilanga {solar} W = {total} W.
energy.room.formula: Ukulahleka kokushisa = Σ U × A × (ngaphakathi − ngaphandle) + Σ U × A × (ngaphakathi − umhlabathi) + 0.335 × ukushintsha komoya × ivolumu × (ngaphakathi − ngaphandle). Amagumbi aseduze abalwa ngokushisa okufanayo.
energy.lambda.intro: Izinto ezingenayo i-U-value ku-IFC zithola yazo emabhodeni ezinto zazo: 1 ÷ (indawo yangaphakathi + Σ ubukhulu ÷ λ + indawo yangaphandle). Ama-λ ajwayelekile ukuqala; thayipha awomkhiqizi.
energy.lambda.none: Akukho nto lapha ethola i-U-value yayo emabhodeni.
energy.err.u: Thayipha i-U-value enkulu kuno-0 futhi engafiki ku-20 W/m²K, noma yishiye ingenalutho ukuze uyisuse.
energy.err.kind: Lolu hlobo lwento alunasikhala esijwayelekile se-U-value.

energy.err.dd-none: Azikho izinombolo kuleyo fayela: umugqa owodwa ngosuku noma ngenyanga, namasosha ezinsuku ekholomini yokugcina.

ws.why.typewalls: Khetha izindonga ezadwetshwa ku-BimCraft, noma qala ukubeka udonga. Izindonga ezilethiwe nezindonga ezinohlobo olungekho noma olungasekelwe azikwazi ukusebenzisa lo mhleli.

ws.why.range3d: Vula ipulani yesitezi kuqala: umbono we-3D awunawo uhla lombono.
ws.why.template: Kusetwe yithempulethi yombono “{name}”. Vula uhla lombono ukuze ubone izilungiselelo zethempulethi.
ws.wall.defaults: Izilungiselelo ezizenzakalelayo zezindonga ezigxilile ezintsha. Izindonga ezikhethiwe zigcina izilungiselelo zazo.
ws.wall.howto: Izindonga ezigxilile lapha; ngodonga ogobile sebenzisa isakhiwo esijwayelekile. Esc iphelisa ukulandelana; Esc futhi ibuyisela ku-Lungisa. Thayipha ubude, izixhumanisi noma izinkonaphi.
ws.wall.straight: Izindonga ezigxilile kulolu hlelo. Ukuze uthole udonga ogobile, shintsha usebenzise isakhiwo esijwayelekile.
ws.wall.noabove: Akukho sitezi phezu kwalolu sitezi. Khetha ukuphakama okuzinzile.

frame.rc.aid: Ukuhlolwa kwekhonkrithi kwamabhimu nezinsika ngokwe-ACI 318-19, ngezisekelo ozisethele ngezansi. Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole: ilusizo kuze kubhekwe yiye umuntu. Imikhosi yokuqala, kodwa insika engagxili yenziwa ngomthwalo wayo okhuliswe (6.6.4.5); ukukhuliswa kokugxila (6.6.4.6) akwakhiwe; akukho ukuklama kokujikeleza, akukho ukuklama kwezokuzamazama (isahluko 18), akukho ukuklama kwezibopho (25.7.2), azikho izindonga njengamapuleti okwamanje.
frame.rc.no-sections: Azikho amabhimu, izinsika noma izibopho okwamanje.
frame.rc.assume-note: Isigaba yidrowing onayo (b ngokuya kwe-y yesakhiwo, h ngokuya kwe-z yaso); ukuhlaziywa kusebenzisa iphrofayili edwetshiwe, futhi umehluko oshaya ngaphezu kuka-5 % ebungeni uyabhalwa. Izinduku ziyizinhlamvu emagumbini okumbozwa anikeziwe; ikhonkrithi yesisindo esijwayelekile; izinhlanganisela ziyezika ze-ASCE 7 (ACI 318-19 5.3.1).
frame.rc.err.no-forms: Setha okungenani isigaba esisodwa kuqala (“Setha njengekhonkrithi…”).
frame.rc.err.no-solution: Ukuhlaziywa akukanaxazululo: lungisa okubikwa yikho, bese uhlola futhi.
frame.rc.err.no-combos: Azikho izinhlanganisela zamandla okuhlolelwa kuzo. Cindezela “Yenza izinhlanganisela” kuqala.
frame.rc.why.area-mismatch: indawo edwetshiwe ihlukile ku-b × h ngaphezu kuka-5 %
frame.rc.title: Ukuhlola kwekhonkrithi
frame.rc.assume-text: Imikhosi yokuqala evela ekuhlaziyweni nge-{stiff}; K = {k}, {sway}; ikhonkrithi yesisindo esijwayelekile (E = 4700 √f’c, ν = 0.2); izinduku njengamaphoyinti; izinhlanganisela ze-ASCE 7. Yokuhlolwa umhlolisisi.
frame.rc.not-built-text: Ukukhuliswa kokugxila (6.6.4.6), ukuklama kokujikeleza, ukuklama kwezokuzamazama (isahluko 18), ukuklama kwezibopho (25.7.2), ukubamba nobude bokuxhumana, ukuhlehla, izindonga.
frame.eq.aid: Amandla angohlangothi alingene (12.8) emaphansini angaphansi njengamacala emithwalo, nokudonsa kwesitezi. Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole: ilusizo kuze kubhekwe yiye umuntu. Ngayinye iphansi iba yidayaphrama eqinile ekuhlaziyweni.
frame.eq.none-found: Akutholakalanga zinga elinamabhimu noma izibopho ezimbili noma ngaphezulu. Engeza amaphansi ngesandla.
frame.eq.no-floors: Awukakabi namaphansi. “Thola amaphansi” ithatha amazinga lapho amabhimu ahlangana; bhala isisindo sephansi ngalinye (ingxenye yalo yomthwalo ongaguquki nanoma yisiphi esinye isisindo sokuzamazama).
frame.eq.floors-note: Bhala isisindo sephansi ngalinye, noma ulifunde emacaleni aphezulu: umthwalo oqondile wenodi ngayinye uya ephansini eliphezulu kwayo noma elifanayo, ngakho insika phakathi kwamaphansi amabili inikeza uhhafu wesisindo sayo kwelingayo. Engeza izigaba, 25 % somthwalo wokuphila wokugcina kanye nekhephu lophahla oluthe tshe (ASCE 7-22 12.7.2) ngesici kulawo macala.

frame.pl.title: Islebhu nezindonga (amapuleti)
frame.pl.method-text: Ama-shell aqinile ane-node ezine (ipuleti le-Mindlin nokusika kwe-MITC4, kanye nomshini), imizuzu nokusika ngemitha yobubanzi ngayinye ezinaksini zepuleti ngalinye (Mx igoba ngokuya kwe-x yepuleti, > 0 = ubuso be-−z ekuqineni). Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole.
frame.pl.limits-text: Imizuzu yokwesekwa ihlangana kancane ngamapuleti ane-node ezine: hlukanisa imeshi eduze kwezisekelo. Imizuzu ephakathi nendawo nokudonsa kuseduze ngamapuleti ayi-16 ngakunye. Amapuleti ahlolwa ngemikhosi kuphela, hhayi ngensimbi yokuqinisa.

sx.vault.intro: Gcina amadwebo efolda yephrojekthi elawulwayo: phuma ngefayela ukuze kungabi nomuntu oliguqulayo, ngenisele njengenguqulo entsha, uyithumele ukuze ibukwe futhi uyikhiphe ngegama lomvumi. Konke kugcinwa efoldeni ngokwalo (ifolda efihliwe i-.ccvault), ngakho ifolda eyabelwanayo noma ehlanganiswa iyasebenza ithimba lonke. Asidingeki iseva.
sx.vault.nofolders: Amafolda ephrojekthi adinga i-CadCraft Studio, noma isiphequluli esisekelwe ku-Chromium (i-Chrome, i-Edge) esingavula ifolda.

eg44.title: Isethi yemvume yokwakha
eg44.intro: Ihlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwemithetho, izinkinga, amashidi nezifomu zakho kanye nemodeli ibe yi-zip eyodwa, nezimvo umhloli wephulani angase azenze. Umhlahlandlela nje kuphela: umsebenzi oyigunyaziwe nomasipala wendawo yiwo azenza isinqumo.

eg60.title: Hlobisa igumbi
eg60.intro: Ibeka impahla yokuqala egumbini ngemithetho, ngaphandle kwemiyango namawindi, ukuze kwenziwe imiboniso. Ukuhlelwa okuzenzakalelayo ukuze uhlole, akusona isakhiwo.

eg48.title: Abantu esakhiweni
eg48.empty: Akutholakalanga amagumbi namasyo. Dwebela kuqala izindonga ezivaliwe namasyo.
eg48.intro: Ihambisa abantu emagumbini, emasyeni nasezitebhisini: ukuphuma esakhiweni, noma ukufika kwansuku zonke. Isivalo ngasinye nesitebhisi ngasinye sivumela abantu ngesilinganiso esithile, ngakho imigqa iyakha lapho isakhiwo sincipha. Lokhu kuhlolwa kokuhlela: imodeli yesixuku esicashile yezinqumo zokwakha, hhayi isitifiketi sokuphepha komlilo.

eg48.model: Isivinini siyancipha igumbi lapho ligcwala (Nelson and MacLennan, S = 1.4 (1 − 0.266 D) m/s). Umnyango uvumela abantu abangu-1.3 ngomzuzwana ngomitha wobubanzi bawo, kususwa u-150 mm ngakolunye uhlangothi ngalunye. Konke lokhu yizimo ocabanga ngazo ongazihlola; imodeli ayazi ngomlilo, intuthu noma ukwesaba.
eg48.legend: Okuluhlaza kuhamba, okuwolintshi kulinde emnyango noma esitebhisini, okuphephuli kusesitebhisini, okungwebu akuqalanga.

eg49.title: Ukuzwakala kwegumbi
eg49.nomodel: Vula imodeli ukuze ubheke ukuzwakala kwamagumbi ayo.
eg49.norooms: Amagumbi awatholakali. Dwebela kuqala izindonga ezivaliwe.
eg49.intro: Umsindo uhlala isikhathi esingakanani egumbini ngalinye (isikhathi sokubuya komsindo, ngebhendi ye-octave) kusuka kubukhulu balo nangalokho okwenziwe ngakho umgaqo, udonga nesiling. Khetha okokuphela; imodeli ayazi ukuthi yini esindonga. Bese uzwa izwi, ukuqhaqhazela kwezandla noma umculo egumbini.
eg49.target: Isikhathi side kakhulu sokubuya komsindo maphakathi (s, ongakukhetha: ukuhlosa kwakho)
eg49.roomline: {name}: indawo yomgaqo {area} m², ukuphakama {h} m, {v} m³.
eg49.mid: Ngama-frequency aphakathi (500 Hz no-1 kHz) isikhathi sokubuya komsindo: {t} s. Umsindo uhamba amamitha {mfp} phakathi kokubuya ngokuvamile.
eg49.nores: Leligumbi alikwazanga ukubalwa: okunye okokugcina akwaziwa.
eg49.model: Imodeli yezibalo: iqagela ukuthi umsindo usakazeka ngokulinganayo nokumuncwa kusakazeke ngokulinganayo. I-Sabine ifanele amagumbi aphilayo ne-Eyring afile; "Esetshenzisiwe" isebenzisa i-Eyring ngaphezu kokumunca okuvamile okungu-0.2. Izinkomba ziyizinani ezivamile ezishicilelwe ukuze uzishintshe ngedatha yokuhlola komkhiqizo. Izitsha, abantu namasyo avulekile akubalwa.
eg49.snd.load: Noma sebenzisa ifayela lakho lomsindo (lihlala kule khompyutha)
eg49.ir.model: Umsindo kuleligumbi wenziwa impendulo ebalwe ngekhompyutha: umsindo oqondile, ukubuya kokuqala kwebhokisi losayizi lowo, nomsila owomela ngesikhathi sokubuya komsindo segumbi ngebhendi ngayinye. Uzwakala njengegumbi losayizi nomgaqo ofanayo, hhayi njengegumbi langempela.
eg49.m.title: Izilinganiso zegumbi (ISO 3382-1)
eg49.m.intro: Isikhathi sokubuya komsindo, ukubola kokuqala, ukucaca nokuchaza ngebhendi ye-octave, kusuka kumpendulo ebalwe ngekhompyutha yegumbi elikhethiwe. Layisha impendulo elinganisiwe (WAV) ukuze uyibone eduze kwesibikezelo; umehluko oludlula i-just-noticeable difference uyamakwa.
eg49.m.bad: Leli fayela alikwazanga ukufundwa njengempendulo ye-WAV.
eg49.m.note: STI akubalwa. Impendulo ebalwe ngekhompyutha ngumfanekiso wezibalo wegumbi: ukuvumelana nokulinganisa kukhombisa ukuthi usayizi nezimo zethe kahle, hhayi ukuthi ngulelo gumbi eliqondile.
eg49.i.title: Izinga lokuvikela komsindo (ISO 717)
eg49.i.intro: Linganisa udonga noma umgaqo ngamanani e-third-octave: izinombolo ezi-Rw, C no-Ctr womoya, noma Ln,w no-CI womsindo wokushaya.
eg49.i.vals: Amanani ayishumi nesithupha kusukela ku-100 Hz kuya ku-3150 Hz (dB), ahlukaniswe ngamakhefana noma izikhala
eg49.i.bad: Kudingeka izinombolo eziyishumi nesithupha kusukela ku-100 Hz kuya ku-3150 Hz.
eg49.i.mass.title: Umthetho wobunzima wodonga oluvamile
eg49.i.mass.note: Umthetho wobunzima ngokungena okuqondile, ovumelekile ngaphansi kwesigamu semvamisa ebucayi. Ukwehla kokuhlangana akulinganiswa, nodonga langempela nezixhumanisi zalo nendlela yokuhamba komsindo ezingxenyeni ezizungezile kudinga ukulinganisa noma i-ISO 12354. Isisekelo sokuklama, hhayi inani eligunyaziwe.

ac.note.dead: Ukumuncwa kuyisilinganiso esingaphezu kwe-0.2 kwamanye amabhendi, ngakho isibalo se-Eyring sisetshenziswa khona.

ep.title: Hlola nge-EnergyPlus
ep.intro: Umbono wesibili ngokushisa nokupholisa amagumbi akho. Umthombo: {name}. Isebenza kuphela uma ucindezela inkinobho, ku-injini oyisethe wena ngokwakho. Umsizi wokuklama osheshayo usalokhu uyimpendulo esheshayo.
ep.not: Umsizi wokuklama, hhayi ukubala kokuthobelwa kwekhodi: amakhodi wamandla, izitifiketi nezimvume zidinga ithuluzi elivunyelwe nedatha yesimo sezulu.

ep.licence: {name} yenziwe yi-U.S. Department of Energy, i-NREL nabanye futhi isetshenziswa ngaphansi kwelayisensi yayo ye-BSD-3-Clause ene-clause yokuqamba igama: injini ibizwa ngokuthi "EnergyPlus version 26.2.0" lapho ikhulunywa khona, futhi amagama e-Department nabasizi awaqinisekisi lolu hlelo. Injini oyikhomba ikopi yakho yona; iphinde ibe nezinye izimtapo-lwazi ezivulekile (i-Eigen ngaphansi kwe-MPL-2.0, i-ObjexxFCL ngaphansi kwelayisensi yayo nesengezo se-EnergyPlus, i-Boost, i-Expat, i-SQLite nezinye) ngaphansi kwemigomo yazo. Akukho lapha okungumbiko wokuthobelwa.

eg47.title: Ukudlala kwengozi
eg47.nomodel: Vula imodeli ukuze udlale ingozi kuyo.
eg47.norooms: Akutholakalanga magumbi. Qala udwebe izindonga ezivaliwe namasemu kuqala.
eg47.intro: Idlala ukuphakama kwesikhukhula emagumbini, umoya ophusha izitezi, noma ukuzamazama okunyakazisa zona. Imodeli elula okuchazwe izimo zayo ngaphansi kwesiphetho ngasinye: indlela yokubona ukuthi ingozi yenza kanjani kulolu hlelo, hhayi ukuhlola kwekhodi noma ukuklama kwesakhiwo.
eg47.peak: Amanzi aphezulu ngaphezu kwesitezi esiphansi kakhulu (m)
eg47.tol: Amanzi amaningi igumbi elingawathatha (m, ngokuzikhethela: umkhawulo wakho)
eg47.mass: Isisindo sesitezi ngakwesikwele somhlaba wesakhiwo (kg; setha ngokwesakhiwo sakho)
eg47.period: Isikhathi sokuqala sesakhiwo (s; ngaphandle: 0.1 s ngesitezi ngasinye)
eg47.drift: Isilinganiso esikhulu sokudonsela esitezini ongasivumela (ukudonsela ÷ ukuphakama, ongakukhetha)
eg47.sum.flood: {n} / {all} amagumbi azomanziswa. Amanzi aphakama ngu-{peak} m ngaphezu kwesitezi esiphansi kakhulu, aphuthelele u-{push} kN ngamitha ngamunye wodonga lwangaphandle kuleso sijula.
eg47.sum.wind: Umoya ongaphansi: ukucindezela {v} kN, umzuzu wokuguquka {m} kN·m.
eg47.sum.quake: Ukucindezela kwesisekelo {v} kN, okuphezulu kunyakaza {top} mm. Isikhathi sokuqala {T} s.
eg47.assumed: Isikhathi sokuqala asinikezwanga, ngakho kusetshenziswa {T} s (ingxenye yesekhondi ngesitezi ngasinye). Faka eyakho ukuze uthole impendulo engcono.
eg47.model.flood: Quasi-static: amanzi angaphakathi alingana namanzi angaphandle noma yiluphi uvulo oluphansi kwawo oluxhumanisa igumbi nangaphandle noma negumbi elimanzi. Imiphetho ephansi kakhulu yeminyango namawindi ngaphezu kwemigangatho yazo yimiphetho ephansi kakhulu; izindonga ziyaqinisa ukuvimbela amanzi; akukho amagagasi, izinga lokugeleza noma izinto ezidonsiwe.
eg47.model.wind: Ingcindezi q = ½ρV², kanti V ikhuphuka ngokuphakama njengomthetho wamandla; amandla = q × isigqi × (0.8 ohlangothini olubhekene nomoya + 0.5 ohlangothini olungabhekene nawo) × ububanzi × ukuphakama kwesitezi. Ukunyakaza kuvela kokuqina okukodwa ngesitezi ngasinye okulingana nesikhathi sokuqala. Akuwona ukuhlolwa kwekhodi yomoya.
eg47.model.quake: Isakhiwo esinyakazayo: ubuningi obubodwa ngomgangatho ngamunye (indawo yomgangatho × kg/m²), ukuqina okufanayo kuwo wonke amasitezi kulingana nesikhathi sokuqala, ukunciphisa kumamodi amabili okuqala, ukuhamba kwesikhathi kwe-Newmark. Okuqinile: akukho okuvuna noma okuqhekeka; akukho ukujikeleza.
eg47.p.flood: {room}: amanzi ajule {d} m, adlula umkhawulo wakho: {tol} m.
eg45.title: Umbono wempilo yonke
eg45.nomodel: Vula imodeli ukuze ubone okuguga phakathi nempilo yayo.
eg45.empty: Imodeli ayinalutho oluhlelwe okwamanje. Qala ngokudweba izindonga, iminyango namawindi.
eg45.intro: Okuqukethwe yimodeli okuguga, nokuthi yiminyaka liphi lapho kushintshwa khona esikhathini sokufunda. Izinsuku zokusebenza zivamile ukuhlelwa: zishintshe ngemikhiqizo nangesimo sezulu sakho. Bhala izindleko ngeyunithi ukuze ubone imali ngonyaka; akukho ezinikezwa.
eg45.sum.cost: Ukushintshwa: {n}. Yonke {total}, inani lamanje {pv}. Unyaka onezindleko ezikhulu kunazo zonke: {year}: {peak}.
eg45.sum.count: Ukushintshwa: {n} phakathi nesikhathi. Engeza izindleko ngeyunithi ukuze ubone imali.
eg45.chart.alt: Lokho okufanele ukhokhwe ngonyaka ngamunye wesikhathi sokufunda
eg45.model: Ingxenye iyashintshwa ngempilo yayo, kabili yempilo yayo njalo njalo uma lokho kusekhona ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokufunda. Izinani zivela emodelini: ukuthambeka nokulahlekelwa akubalwa, kanti amapayipi, izintambo nemishini akukakafaki emodelini. Izindleko zisemalini yamanje uma ungakanikezi izinga lokukhuphuka kwentengo.
eg46.title: Izimo zesimo sezulu sesikhathi esizayo
eg46.intro: Letha isimo sakho sesimo sezulu (ifayela le-JSON noma le-CSV elinonyaka, ukuphakama kwezinga lolwandle ngomitha nesici sokugeleza, kusuka emthonjeni oyeThembayo) bese ugeleza kwenziwa ngalowo nyaka. Uhlelo alunadatha yesimo sezulu.

eg46.noexact: Lowo nyaka uphandle kweminyaka yesimo sezulu: amanani aseduze agcinwa, awelulwa.

frame.slab.title: Ukuqiniswa kwe-islebhu (ACI 318-19)
frame.slab.aid: Insimbi i-islebhu eyenziwe ngamapuleti iyidingayo, kusuka ezikhathini zamapuleti kuyo yonke inhlanganisela yamandla: izikhathi zokugoba nokujikeleza ndawonye ngomthetho we-Wood–Armer, ungqimba phansi nangaphezulu ngayinye yezinqubo, bese kuba ukuhlinza kwendlela eyodwa. Isisiza umndeni wobunjiniyela ukuhlola.
frame.slab.done: Kuklanywe amapuleti {n} ezinhlanganisweni {combos}: ungqimba olusetshenziswa kakhulu: {util}.
frame.slab.err.no-combos: Yenza kuqala izinhlanganisela zamandla bese uqalisa ukuhlaziya.
frame.slab.limits: Akuhlanganisiwe: ukukhothama (ubukhulu buyinto yakho), ukungena kwamandla emakholomini, izinti ezihlaziyayo ezizungeze izimbobo, ukunciphisa kanye nokuxhuma. Izinqumo ezingaphezu kokuxhaswa ziya ngokuya kancane ngamapuleti amane: hlaziya imeshi lapho. Ungqimba x uyiwona ongaphandle.

frame.rc.why.slender-sway: ukukhuliswa kokunyakaza (6.6.4.6) akukakhiwa: kudinga ukuhlaziywa kwesibili.
frame.rc.check.rc-slender-buckling: Ikholomu ende: umthwalo oqondile ngokuchasene ne-0.75 Pc (6.6.4.5.2)
frame.break.aid: Ithola okuzoqala ukuvela ohlakeni: inhlanganisela yamandla ebusayo, ilunga elibuthakathaka, isilinganiso somthwalo lapho ilunga lokuqala lifinyelela umkhawulo walo (inhlanganisela ebusayo ekalwe kabusha, ixazululwe futhi ngalo lonke ikhathi), kanye nesixhumanisi esibuthakathaka sezikulufo lapho imodeli ibhala ukuthi izikulufo zithwala ni. Isebenzisa izilungiselelo zokuklama ezingenhla.
frame.break.none-yet: Cindezela inkinobho ukuze uthole. Yenza kuqala izinhlanganisela bese usetha ikhodi yokuklama ngenhla.
frame.break.reserve: Ukukala leyo nhlanganisela, ilunga lokuqala lifinyelela umkhawulo walo ngezikhathi {f} zomthwalo.
frame.break.reserve-unbounded: Ukukala leyo nhlanganisela, akukho okufinyelela umkhawulo (ukusesha kumi ngezikhathi {f} zomthwalo).
frame.break.not-checked: Izixhumanisi {n} azinakho ukumelana kwezikulufo futhi azihlolwa.
frame.break.limits: Ixhume lihlolwa ngokuhlinza nangomthwalo wokuqonda kuphela, kusukela ezimpenjini zelungu, ngokuchasene namandla okuhlinza ezikulufweni (AISC 360-16 J3.6, φ = 0.75). Ukucindezela, ukuhlinza kwebhlokhi, izinsimbi zokushisela kanye nokuphula akuhlolwa. Ukukhululeka kuwukuxazulula kokuqala okuphindwe kabili, akukona ukuhlaziywa kwesibili.

eg47.fr.src.period: Ukuqina okukodwa ngesitezi ngasinye, kulingana nesikhathi engikunikezayo
eg47.fr.intro: Kuphushwa ngakunye kwemigangatho ngokuhlukana, bese uhlaka luyaxazululwa; ukuqina kwemigangatho, lapho wonke amabhimu nezinsika sebenza ndawonye, kuthatha isikhathi esibhalwe. Isisindo singesezitho zalo nomthwalo womgangatho ongezansi ebhokisini lepulani lomgangatho ngamunye. Isikhathi sangempela sibonakala emiphumeleni. Okuqinile: akukho ukuvuna.
eg47.fr.noframe: Akukho hlaka elingafundwa: lo modeli awunawo amabhimu, insika noma izitho ethebhu ye-Analysis engazisebenzisa.
eg47.fr.nofloors: Uhlaka alunamigangatho ngaphezu kwesisekelo salo (izinodi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ebudeni obufanayo).
eg48.sc.exchange: Ukushintshana: abantu abakumagumbi bayahamba kanti abanjalo bayangena
eg48.done.exchange: Abafike lapho bebheke khona: {n} / {all}; bonke badlule ngemizuzwana {s}.
eg48.counts.hint: Ibhokisi elingenalutho lisebenzisa inani lendawo elingenhla (inombolo emnyama); bhala 0 ukuze ukhiphe igumbi.
people.p.counter: Ukugeleza okuphambene emnyango noma esitezini: abantu badlule ngakolunye uhlangothi izikhathi {n} besondelene, ngakho kudlule ngaphansi kwezinga lakho.
eg49.place.title: Umthombo nomlaleli
eg49.place.hint: Beka umthombo (ophakama ngo-1.5 m) nomlaleli (ophakama ngo-1.2 m) epulanini; umsindo odlalwayo uzwakala kusuka lapho. Ngaphandle kwabo, umlaleli umi endaweni ekude ngaphansi.
eg45.carbon.sum: Ukushintshwa kubuyisele {kg} kg CO2e ({t} t) ohlelweni lokufunda.
eg45.carbon.none: Akukho ngxenye enesici sekhabhoni emodelini, ngakho akukho khabhoni ebaliwe.
eg45.carbon.missing: Akukho khabhoni ezibhalwe: {list} (akukho sinto enesici, noma akukho inani).
eg45.carbon.model: Ingxenye yokushintsha ibalwa ngekhabhoni yemodeli ngeyunithi yalolo hlobo lwento (izici ze-Carbon, ukukhiqizwa kanye nemodyuli evulekile lapho). Ukuphela kwempilo yengxenye endala nomsebenzi wokuyishintsha akubalwa.
eg45.note.wiring: Izintambo zilinganiswa ngezinkinga zepulani phakathi kwezinsiza zesekethe ngayinye.
eg45.note.nocarbon: Imodeli alinayo imiphumela yekhabhoni okufundwa kuyo.
access.stage: Isihlahla semodeli, ukuhamba ngekhibhodi. Imicibisholo engenhla nengaphansi noma Tab zihamba phakathi kwendawo, isakhiwo, izitezi nezigaba zento zesitezi ngasinye; Enter ikhetha konke okungaphansi kwakho, D ichaza isakhiwo, S ifunda into ekhethiwe, N iqamba omakhelwane, uphawu lombuzo ludweba uhlu lwezinkinobho.
lesson.first.title: Imodeli yakho yokuqala
lesson.first.intro: Vula isakhiwo, wengeze udonga nomnyango, bese uyasilondoloza. Isinyathelo ngasinye sihlola imodeli ngokwayo.
lesson.first.open: Vula imodeli ye-IFC (Ifayela › Vula), noma qala isakhiwo esisha.
lesson.first.open.h1: Inkinobho ethi Vula isethulusini lamafayela, esiqenjini sokuqala.
lesson.first.wall.h1: Vula ibha yokudweba bese ukhetha Udonga.
lesson.first.wall.h2: Chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala, bese iphoyinti lokugcina epulanini.
lesson.first.door.h1: Khetha Umnyango kubha yokudweba, bese uchofoza kudonga.
lesson.first.save.h1: Ctrl+S ilondoloza ikhophi; umsuka wakho uhlala ungathintwanga.
totals.time.note: Izinsuku zokusebenza (Mvulo kuya Ngolwesihlanu) kusuka ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, amahora ayi-8 ngosuku; amaholide awafundwa.
breakit.p.combo: {subject} yinhlanganisela ebusayo: ilunga elisetshenziswa kakhulu lifinyelela {util}.
breakit.p.combo.fail: {subject} yinhlanganisela ebusayo, futhi ilunga liphezu komkhawulo walo ({util}).
breakit.p.member: {subject} yilo elibuthakathaka kakhulu: {util} komkhawulo walo; ekukaleni imithwalo, liyanikezela ngesilinganiso {factor}×.
breakit.p.member.fail: {subject} udlula umkhawulo walo ({util}) esethini {set}: imithwalo ingaphezu kalokho ayithathayo ngesilinganiso {factor}×.
breakit.p.connection: {subject} ukuxhumana okubuthakathaka kakhulu: {shearKN} kN ekuhlinzeni, ngokuchasene nezikulufo ezithwala {resistKN} kN ({util}).
breakit.p.connection.fail: {subject} uyalayishwa ngokweqile: {shearKN} kN ekuhlinzeni, ngokuchasene nezikulufo ezithwala {resistKN} kN ({util}).
breakit.p.reserve: Imithwalo ingakhula ngesilinganiso {factor}× ngaphambi kokuthi ilunga lokuqala lifinyelele umkhawulo walo.
breakit.p.reserve.fail: Imithwalo sekuyisilinganiso {factor}× kalokho okuthathwa yilunga lokuqala.
breakit.p.route: {subject}: umnyango omncane kakhulu endleleni yokuphuma ububanzi bawo {width} mm; umthetho udinga {need} mm ({door}).
breakit.p.route.fail: {subject}: indlela yokuphuma incane kakhulu. Umnyango omncane kakhulu endleleni engcono ububanzi bawo {width} mm kanti umthetho udinga {need} mm ({door}); {reachable} kuyafinyelelwa.
mepc.light.site: Indawo yesakhiwo noma yangaphandle (okuzikhethela; amakhona x, y ngo-mm, owodwa emgqeni ngamunye)
mepc.light.site.name: Indawo yesakhiwo
mepc.light.map: Imephu yokukhanya, {name}: okuluhlaza akukho kukhanya, okubomvu kukhanya okukhulu kakhulu: {max} lx.
mepc.light.map.fine: {name}: amaphoyinti egridi {n} amaningi kakhulu ukuwadweba; khulisa ibanga legridi ukuze ubone imephu.
solids.sum: Izinto {n}: {parametric} zigcina ukwakheka kwazo njengamapharamitha (ukuphuma, ukujikeleza, ukuhamba, nama-Boolean), {tessellated} ziluhlu lwamanxantathu, kanti {brep} ngamasolidi wemingcele ({pct}% ayahlelwa).
solids.keep.title: Ibhala kabusha uluhlu ngalunye lwamanxantathu olufana ngokuphelele neprizimu eqondile njengokuphuma: ifayela elincane, nobude bayo nesakhiwo sayo kungahlelwa kamuva. Okunye konke kuhlala njengoba kunjalo.
solids.done: Izimo {n} manje ziwukuphuma; izinhlu zamanxantathu {skipped} azilona amaprizimu futhi zisalile njengoba zazinjalo.
solids.none: Akukho luhlu lwamanxantathu kule modeli oluyiprizimu eqondile; akukho okushintshiwe.
crs.pick.name: Ukuprojekta okwenziwe
crs.pick.long: Leyo nkcazelo inde kakhulu ukuze ibe ukuprojekta.
crs.pick.bad: Ukuprojekta akukwazanga ukwakhiwa kuleyo nkcazelo. Hlola igama elithi +proj= namapharamitha alo.
crs.pick.unit: Iyunithi kufanele ibe mitha, amafidi noma amafidi wesivivinyo wase-US (+units=m, ft noma us-ft, noma +to_meter=).
crs.pick.use: Leyo nkcazelo iyakhiwa, kodwa ayiguquli ubude nobubanzi babe amaphoyinti emephu ibuyele emuva, ngakho ayisebenziseki.
crs.pick.matched: Lokhu kunikeza izixhumanisi ezifanayo ne-EPSG:{code}, {name}: leyo khodi iyasetshenziswa.
crs.pick.nocode: I-EPSG:{code} ayikho oluhlwini. Sesha ngegama, noma unamathisele inkcazo.
geo.pick.model.title: Uhlelo lwezixhumanisi lwalo modeli
geo.pick.target.title: Ububanzi nobude kusetshenziswa
geo.pick.model.intro: Tshela ukuthi izixhumanisi zemephu zalo modeli zisemephu yuhlelo luni. Sesha ngenombolo ye-EPSG, ngesifunda se-UTM (UTM 33N) noma ngamagama asegameni, namathisela inkcazo yokuprojekta, layisha ifayela .prj, noma khetha eyakho. Iyagcinwa emodelini.
geo.pick.target.intro: Uhlelo i-Measure › Location inikeza umphumela ngalo, ngaphezu kwezixhumanisi zemephu zemodeli ngokwayo. Noma iyiphi i-EPSG, isifunda se-UTM noma ukuprojekta kwakho.
geo.pick.name: Igama
geo.pick.hits.more: Izinhlelo zokuqala: {n}. Engeza amagama ukuze uncishise.
geo.pick.mine.none: Akukho okwamanje. Inkcazo oyinamathisele noma i-.prj oyilayisha ingagcinwa lapha.
geo.pick.current.file: Akukho kukhetha okugcinwe kule modeli; ifayela libiza {crs}.
geo.pick.nomap: Leli fayela alinayo iguquko yemephu (IfcMapConversion): uhlelo lugcinwa emodelini, namaphoyinti emephu namafu alandela lona uma imodeli ibekwe emephu.
geo.pick.geographic: Uhlelo lwesilinganiso sobude nobubanzi akukwazi ukuba yigridi yemephu yemodeli. Khetha uhlelo oluprojekthiwe (i-UTM, isakhiwo sesifunda, igridi kazwelonke noma eyakho).
geo.pick.model.set: {name} uhlelo lwezixhumanisi lwalo modeli. Londoloza imodeli ukuze uyigcine.
geo.pick.model.cleared: Ukukhetha kohlelo lwezixhumanisi lwemodeli kususiwe. Londoloza imodeli ukuze lokho kugcinwe.
measure.crs.title: Khetha ukuprojekta kwemephu yalo modeli: isifunda se-UTM, ikhodi ye-EPSG noma inkcazo yakho
pic.title: Izithombe
pic.tool.title: Beka isithombe se-PNG, JPEG noma WebP ngaphansi kwepulani laleli zinga: silinganise ngamaphoyinti amabili, hambisa, phendula, fiphaza futhi ukhiye, bese udweba phezu kwaso
pic.insert.title: Khetha ifayela le-PNG, JPEG noma WebP; lifundwa kusiphequluli sakho, aliyiswa, futhi ligcinwa nemodeli
pic.scale.title: Chofoza amaphoyinti amabili esithombeni, bese ubhala ibanga langempela phakathi kwawo
pic.move.title: Chofoza iphoyinti lesisekelo esithombeni, bese kuthi lapho kufanele kuye khona
pic.pick: Khetha isithombe kuqala: chofoza kuso, noma ukhethe kohlu.
pic.placed: {name} ibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Sebenzisa Isikali ukusetha usayizi wayo.
pic.placed.reduced: {name} yehliswe usayizi ukuze ihlale nemodeli. Sebenzisa Isikali ukusetha usayizi wayo.
pic.hint: Faka isithombe, noma chofoza esinye ukuze usisebenzise. Isikali, Hambisa, Phendula, Ukubonakala kanye neKhiya kushintsha isithombe esikhethiwe.
pic.hint.scale1: Isikali: chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala kwamabili esithombeni okwaziwa ibanga layo langempela.
pic.hint.scale3: Isikali: bhala ibanga langempela phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili bese ucindezela Enter. Esc ikhansela.
pic.hint.move2: Hambisa: chofoza lapho leliphoyinti kufanele liye khona. Esc ikhansela.
pic.paste.name: Isithombe esinamathisiwe
pic.paste.noplan: Bonisa ipulani lezinga (Dweba) ukuze unamathisele isithombe kulo.
pic.paste.real: {name} inamathiselwe ngosayizi wayo wangempela ({w} x {h}) kusukela ekalini leshidi. Sebenzisa Hambisa ukuze uyibeke endaweni.
pic.paste.paper: {name} inamathiselwe ngosayizi wephepha ({w} x {h}): ishidi lawo alinaso isikali sokudweba. Chofoza amaphoyinti amabili kuwo bese ubhala ibanga lawo langempela ukuze uwulinganise.
pic.err.type: Leli fayela alisona isithombe se-PNG, JPEG noma WebP.
pic.err.big: Lesi sithombe sikhulu kakhulu ukuze sigcinwe nemodeli, nanoma sehliswe usayizi.
pic.err.locked: Isithombe sikhiyiwe. Vula ukhiyo ukuze usihambise, usiphendule noma usilinganise.
pic.err.distance: Bhala ibanga langempela phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili njengobude obukhulu kune-0.
pic.prob.unscaled: Isithombe {name} asikalwanga okwamanje, ngakho usayizi waso uyinqikaza.
pic.plane.title: Lapho kubekwa isithombe esisha: ngaphansi kwepulani yalo zinga, noma simi ngokuqondile phezu komugqa wesigaba okhetha wona kwipulani
pic.bundle.title: Londoloza imodeli nezithombe zayo ndawonye njengefayela le-.ccbundle: izithombe zihlala ngaphandle kombhalo we-IFC, ngakho i-IFC ihlala incane futhi ukuhlela kuyashesha
pic.state.vertical: Indiza eqondile phezu komugqa: ubude {len}, {w} x {h} px
pic.hint.line1: Indiza eqondile: chofoza ekupheleni kokuqala komugqa wesigaba kwipulani (ukuphela kodonga kuyabamba).
pic.hint.line2: Indiza eqondile: chofoza ekupheleni kwesibili komugqa. Isithombe sizomi phezu kwezinga phezu kwawo. Esc ikhansela.
pic.line.start: {name}: khetha umugqa wesigaba kwipulani ngokuchofoza kabili.
pic.placed.vertical: {name} sibekwe endizeni eqondile. Sibonakala kumbono we-3D; sebenzisa Ububanzi, Ecaleni komugqa kanye Nokuphakama ukusibeka.
pic.err.cap: Izinga lingabamba izithombe {n} kuphela, ukuze imibono ishesha. Qala ngokususa esinye.
pic.prob.lost: Isithombe {name} sagcinwa esethini yephrojekthi futhi isithombe sawo asikulefayela. Vula i-.ccbundle esagcinelwa kuyo.
pic.lost.note: Izithombe {n} zingeyesethi yephrojekthi engavulwanga, ngakho zingekho lapha. Vula i-.ccbundle ezagcinelwa kuyo.
pic.save.title: Gcina izithombe kanye nemodeli
pic.save.text: Le modeli inezithombe {n} ({mb} MB) ezigcinwe ngaphandle kombhalo we-IFC. Ifayela elilula le-.ifc alikwazi ukuzibamba ngaphandle kokuba likhule kakhulu.
pic.save.left: Ukufaka izithombe ezingafiki: {kb} KB kuphela kuzoshiya {n} ngaphandle kwefayela elilula le-IFC.
pic.save.lost: Izithombe {n} azinadatha yesithombe futhi zizoshiya kunoma ikuphi.
pic.save.embed: Gcina i-IFC elula (ifaka izithombe {n} ezingafiki {kb} KB)
pic.save.leftout: Izithombe {n} azikho kulo fayela elilula le-IFC. Londoloza njengesethi ukuze uzigcine.
pic.pdf.failed: Izithombe zalo zinga azikwazanga ukulungiswa ye-PDF futhi zashiywa ngaphandle.
pic.secline.title: Ngendiza eqondile: ma isithombe phezu komugqa wesigaba oqanjiwe walo zinga, noma khetha amaphoyinti amabili kunalokho
pic.secline.name: Isigaba {name}
georef.p.area: Le ndawo (ubude bomhlaba {lon}, ububanzi bomhlaba {lat}) ingaphandle kwendawo {name} (EPSG:{code}) eyenzelwe yona ({w}, {s}, {e}, {n}). Izinombolo zisasebenza, kodwa ukuguquka kuyakhula uma ukhula kuyo.
georef.p.grid: {name} idinga igridi yokushintsha kwedatam {grid}, futhi ukushintsha okusekelwe egrijini akutholakali lapha. Khetha uhlelo ku-datam engadingi igridi, noma layisha igridi kuqala.
georef.p.noshift: {name} akakhombisi ukushintsha kwedatam ukuya ku-WGS 84, ngakho amakhoordinethi adluliselwa njengokuthi zombili izidatam zifana.
georef.p.approx: Kusukela {from} kuya {to} kushintsha idatam ngokushintsha okungadingi igridi. Ukushintsha okusekelwe egrijini akutholakali, ngakho umphumela useduze nokunemba okushiwo okungaba ngu-{acc} m.
georef.p.approx.unknown: Kusukela {from} kuya {to} kushintsha idatam ngokushintsha okungadingi igridi okungakhonjwa ukunemba kwakho. Ukushintsha okusekelwe egrijini akutholakali, ngakho umphumela useduze.
georef.p.nofinite: Ububanzi bedatha bunezinombolo ezingapheli, ngakho ayikwazi ukuphindaphindwa kabusha.
georef.p.outside: Iphoyinti lingaphandle kwalokho {name} angakwazi ukukuprojekthela (alijikeleziswa libe ubude nobubanzi bomhlaba). Hlola izinombolo nohlelo.
georef.p.projected: Khetha uhlelo olunoprojekthi (i-UTM, i-state plane, igridi kazwelonke noma eyakho): uhlelo lobude nobubanzi bomhlaba alikwazi ukuba yigridi yemephu.
georef.p.latlon: Ububanzi bomhlaba kumele bube phakathi kuka-(-90) kuya ku-90 nobude phakathi kuka-(-180) kuya ku-180.
georef.p.numbers: Ama-easting, ama-northing, ukuphakama nokujikeleza kumele kube yizinombolo ezingaphakathi kobubanzi bemephu.
georef.p.scale: Isikali {scale} asisebenziseki: kumele sibe sihle futhi sisondele kumehluko weyunithi phakathi kwemodeli nemephu.
georef.p.toolarge: Amaphoyinti {n} aningi kakhulu ukuthi angaphindaphindwa ngesikhathi esisodwa (umkhawulo ngu-{max}). Layisha ifayela elinamaphoyinti amancane bese uzama futhi.
georef.p.dropped: Amaphoyinti {n} alikwazanga ukuprojekthwa futhi ashiywa ngaphandle.
georef.origin.title: Beka le modeli kwimephu
georef.origin.intro: Le modeli ayinakho ukuguqulwa kwemephu okwamanje. Tshela lapho umsuka wayo usemephini ku-{name}: ama-easting nama-northing, noma ububanzi nobude bomhlaba okuguqulwa ngohlelo. Ukuguqulwa kwemephu kubhalwa kwifayela; imodeli ngokwayo ayinyakazi.
georef.origin.intro2x3: Le fayela yi-IFC2X3, engenakho ukuguqulwa kwemephu. Izinombolo ezifanayo zibhalwa ngendlela evunyelwe yileso sindinganiso: amasethi wempahla ye-buildingSMART i-ePSet_MapConversion ne-ePSet_ProjectedCRS kweprojekthi, ububanzi nobude bomhlaba besakhiwo, kanye nenyakatho yeqiniso.
georef.origin.rot: Ukujikeleza kuya enyakatho yegridi (amadigri, ngokuphambene newashi)
georef.origin.rot.help: 0 kusho ukuthi i-Y axis yemodeli ibheka enyakatho yegridi.
georef.origin.scale.help: Okuzenzakalelayo kuguqula kuphela iyunithi yemodeli ibe yeyemephu. Sebenzisa enye inani kuphela uma kuyisici sokuhlanganisa somhlaba kuya egridini.
georef.origin.done: Imodeli isemephini ku-{name} ku-E {e}, N {n}. Londoloza imodeli ukuze uyigcine.
georef.origin.done2x3: Imodeli isemephini ku-{name} ku-E {e}, N {n}, ibhalwe njengamasethi wempahla (IFC2X3). Londoloza imodeli ukuze uyigcine.
georef.choice.title: Shintsha uhlelo lwemodeli
georef.choice.intro: Le fayela lizibeka kwimephu ku-{old}. Ukhethe {new}.
georef.choice.only.help: Ifayela ligcina ukubekwa kwalo kwesobunjalo. I-Measure › Location, izendlalelo zemephu namafu amaphoyinti asebenzisa {new} kule modeli.
georef.choice.move.help: Ukuguqulwa kwemephu nohlelo lweprojekthi lwefayela kubhalwa kabusha ukuze i-IFC egciniwe ithi {new}. Indawo emhlabeni ihlala ifanayo; akukho okuhambayo ngaphakathi kwemodeli.
georef.choice.preview: Umsuka usuka ku-E {e0}, N {n0} waya ku-E {e1}, N {n1}; ukujikeleza {r0}° kuya {r1}°; isikali {s0} kuya {s1}. Ububanzi {lat} nobude {lon} buhlala bufanayo.
georef.choice.moved: Ukubekwa kwejografi kwemodeli manje kuthi {name}. Londoloza imodeli ukuze uyigcine.
georef.file.title: Le fayela lisohlelweni olwehlukile
georef.file.help: Ukuphrojekthela kabusha kushintsha ikhophi ku-BimCraft kuphela; ifayela kukhompyutha yakho alithintwa.
georef.file.ask.title: Le fayela lisohlelweni oluphi lwamakhoordinethi?
georef.file.ask.intro: {file} ayitsheli ukuthi isohlelweni oluphi lwamakhoordinethi. Khetha lona; i-BimCraft izikhumbula impendulo yale fayela.
georef.file.done: Ifayela {file}: amaphoyinti {n} aphrojekthelwe kabusha, {from} kuya {to}. Ifayela ngokwalo alithintekile.
georef.file.nomodel: Imodeli ayinaho uhlelo lwamakhoordinethi okwamanje. Khetha olunye ngaphansi kwe-Measure › Uhlelo lwamakhoordinethi… kuqala.
georef.file.reopen: Ukuze ubuyele kuhlelo lwalo lwefayela, vula ifayela futhi.
measure.georef.title: Beka imodeli kwimephu, noma shintsha lapho ikhona: ama-easting nama-northing, ukujikeleza kuya enyakatho yegridi kanye nesikali
georef.p.nofrom: Ifayela libiza uhlelo lwemephu olungekho kuhlu, ngakho ukubekwa kwalo kwejografi akukwazi ukuhanjiswa kuya {name}. Kuphela okubikwa yi-Location kushintshiwe.
georef.origin.pickfirst: Khetha uhlelo lwamakhoordinethi lwemodeli kuqala; isinyathelo esilandelayo sibeka imodeli kwimephu.
georef.origin.already: Le modeli sesivele ibekwe kwimephu: {name}. Ukuyihambisa kolunye uhlelo, khetha lolo hlelo ngaphansi kwe-Measure › Uhlelo lwamakhoordinethi….
georef.cloud.title: Hambisa leli fu kuhlelo lwamakhoordinethi lwemodeli (ifayela ngokwalo alishintshwa), noma tshela ukuthi ifayela lisohlelweni oluphi
ml.sys.more.help: Bhala isifunda se-UTM noma inombolo ye-EPSG, noma thatha uhlelo kumaProjekshini ami. Likhethwa lapha bese lisetshenziswa ngo-Sebenzisa lolu hlelo, bese ligcinwa ku-DWG noma DXF.
ml.sys.more.chosen: {name} ikhethiwe. Setha indawo bese ucindezela Sebenzisa lolu hlelo.

tji.err.version: Itafula liyinguqulo {v}; i-BimCraft lapha ifunda inguqulo 1.

sp.title: Qhathanisa ukuskena nemodeli
sp.intro: Ihlola yonke into yemodeli ngokumelene namafu amaphoyinti avulekile: yakhiwe (ukuskena kuyibona indawo yayo), ingxenye, ayikho (ukuskena kukhona kodwa into ayikho) noma ayibonwe (ukuskena kangizange kufike lapho). Uma kulayishwe uhlelo lwe-4D, futhi ithi yiziphi izinto ezingemuva noma ezingaphambili ngosuku lwe-4D.
sp.nocloud: Vula ifu lamaphoyinti kuqala: lokhu kuqhathanisa ukuskena nemodeli.
sp.fail.toolarge: Ukuskena nemodeli kukude kakhulu ukuthi kuqhathaniswe: beka ifu phezu kwemodeli kuqala.

sp.noplan: Akukho uhlelo lwe-4D olulayishiwe, ngakho akukho okushiwo ngemuva noma ngaphambili.
sp.prob.behind: Kufanele ukuba {name} yakhiwe ngosuku {day}, kodwa iskena siyibona njengo: {state}.
sp.prob.off: {name} imi cishe {mm} mm kusuka endaweni yayo emodelini.
sp.limits: Ukuqhathaniswa kwebhokisi ngalinye lento namaphoyinti eskena, ngaphakathi kokubekezelela okusethile: akuyona inkundla, akuyona inani noma isisekelo sokukhokha. Izinto ezakhiwe ngengxenye zibalwa ngokwahlukana. Into ekude endaweni yayo ingafundeka njengengekho, futhi into efihliwe ngakwenye elinjiwe ingafundeka njengeyakhiwe ngoba zabelana ngendawo efanayo. Buka uhlu ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo ngalo.

eg49.u.title: Ukungafani kokumunca (igumbi elinebhokisi)
eg49.u.intro: U-Sabine no-Eyring baqagela ukuthi zonke izindawo zimunca ngokulinganayo. Lapho indawo eyodwa imunca khona iningi (ikhaphethi ngaphansi kolwelwesi oluqinile), bafunda isikhathi side kakhulu. U-Fitzroy no-Arau-Puchades bathatha amapheya amathathu ezindawo ezibhekene ngokwahlukana. Bhala igumbi njengebhokisi bese ukhetha izinto zalo zokugcina.
eg49.u.uneven: Amapheya amathathu ezindawo amunca ngokwehlukile kakhulu lapha. Thembela ku-Fitzroy noma ku-Arau-Puchades kunaku-Sabine, futhi lindela ukuthi igumbi langempela libe phakathi kwawo.
eg49.u.fs: Phansi kwefrikhwensi engaba ngu: {fs} Hz, legumbi linamagagasi amile ahlukene, hhayi inkundla yomsindo elinganayo (ifrikhwensi ka-Schroeder kusuka esikhathini sokuphindisa, isikhathi: {t} s). Izibalo zokuphindisa ngenhla azichazi lawo mabhendi aphansi.
eg49.u.modes.note: Izindlela eziphansi kakhulu zebhokisi elingenalutho nelingashintshi (eziqondile, ezithintayo nezithambekile, zibhalwa njengezinombolo ezintathu zezindlela). Igebe elincane kakhulu phakathi kwezindlela ezimbili ezingaphansi kwe-120 Hz lingu: {gap} Hz; izindlela ezisondelene zenza inothi elikhala. Isisekelo sokuklama, hhayi ukukala.

xr.why.none: Akukho ikhanda le-VR lapha: lesi siphequluli asinayo i-WebXR. Vula leli khasi kwisiphequluli sekhanda ngokwalo, noma ku-Chrome noma ku-Edge nekhanda le-PC elixhunyiwe.

xr.started: Ku-VR: gqoka ikhanda. Phuma ku-VR kusukela kumenyu ngesandla sakho sokhohlo.
xr.ended: Ubuyile ku-VR: ukubuka kulapho omi khona.
xr.status.start: Chopha bese ucindezela ukhiye ukuze uhambe. Shayela intonga ngasohlangothini ukuze uphendule, phambili ukuze ulungiselele ukudlula.
xr.status.teleport: Chopha phansi bese ucindezela ukhiye ukuze uye lapho.
xr.status.measure: Cindezela ukhiye kumaphuzu amabili ukuze ulinganise phakathi kwawo.
xr.status.section: Cindezela ukhiye odongeni noma phansi ukuze ulisike livuleke.
xr.status.issue: Cindezela ukhiye lapho kukhona inkinga: ibekwa nesithombe salokho obukayo.
xr.room.on: Usayizi ophelele: hamba uzungeze ngokhiye noma intonga.
xr.table.on: Imodeli yetafula elingaphezulu: hamba uzungeze kuyo, noma uyiphendulele ngentonga.
xr.table.noteleport: Kumodeli yetafula hamba uzungeze kuyo: khetha Usayizi ophelele ukuze ugxume.
xr.floor.only: Ungagxuma phansi kuphela: chopha endaweni ebheke phezulu.
xr.issue.title: Inkinga {n} (VR)
xr.issue.placed: Inkinga {n} ibekiwe. Itholakala ohlwini lwezinkinga uma uphuma ku-VR.
xr.section.plan: Ukusika kwesicwebo ku-1.2 m ngaphezulu kwaphansi. Sula kususa kona.
xr.ar.title: Bonisa imodeli ngobukhulu bayo bonke ngaphezu kwekhamera yocingo ensimini. Bheka, ungamaki.
xr.ar.why.not-a-phone: I-AR ensimini isebenza ocingweni lwe-Android oluno-Chrome. Lona alilona: bheka imodeli nge-3D lapha, noma vula leli khasi ocingweni.
xr.ar.why.no-webxr: Leli bhrawuza alinayo i-WebXR AR. Sebenzisa i-Chrome ocingweni lwe-Android.
xr.ar.why.ios: I-AR ensimini idinga ucingo lwe-Android oluno-Chrome. Ku-iPhone noma ku-iPad, sebenzisa ukubuka kwemodeli nge-3D.
xr.ar.why.webview: Le app ayikwazi ukubonisa i-AR ngokwayo: vula leli khasi lifanayo ku-Chrome ocingweni.
xr.ar.started: Ku-AR: linganisa imodeli namaphoyinti amabili ensimini. Bheka, ungamaki.
xr.ar.step1: Ma lapho: {where}. Qondanisa indilinga eluhlaza emhlabeni lapho, bese uthepha Beka iphoyinti.
xr.ar.step2: Manje ma endaweni yesibili: {where}, qondanisa emhlabeni bese uthepha Beka iphoyinti.
xr.ar.step.recheck: Ma lapho: {where}, qondanisa emhlabeni bese uthepha Beka iphoyinti ukuhlola ukuhlelwa.
xr.ar.aligned: Imodeli ihlelwe esayithini. Ukuphambuka emaphoyintini amabili: {m} noma ngaphansi.
xr.ar.lined: Ihlelwe, ukuphambuka emaphoyintini amabili: {m} noma ngaphansi.
xr.ar.note: Ucingo lusetshenziselwa ukubuka kuphela: ungalinganisi noma uthathe izilinganiso kulo mbono.
xr.ar.nohit: Ubuso abutholakalanga okwamanje: hambisa ucingo kancane phezu komhlaba.
xr.ar.close: Lawo maphoyinti amabili ngaphansi kwesigamu semitha ngokuhlukana: qala kabusha namaphoyinti asuke kakhulu.
xr.ar.re.again: Ukuphambuka {m}: khomba lezi zindawo amabili futhi.

nest.title: Uhlu lokusika — izinti zokuthenga: {bars}, {waste} % okulahlwayo
nest.none: Azikho amabhimu, izinsika noma izimbambo zokusika.
nest.note: Amabhimu, izinsika, izimbambo nezinsimbi zesitebe ngesamba lengxenye, zisikwa kusuka ezintini zephrofayili nezinto ngazinye: izingcezu ezinde kakhulu kuqala zingena entini yokuqala okulingana nazo, bese ngayinye yentinti ithengwa njengobude obufushane bezitoko obuthatha ukusikwa kwayo. Ukusika ngakunye kuthatha umkhondo wokusika; intinti ngayinye ilahlekelwa ukusikwa kwemiphetho. Insalela ebanzi okungenani ubude bokugcina ibuyela esitokweni; eyimfishane ilahlwa. Amapuleti asikwa ngeshidi futhi awahlelwa lapha.

frm.intro: Amaphaneli amadonga, amaflowa namaphahla ngokhuni noma insimbi ekhanyayo: yonke ingxenye, uhlu lokusika, udwebo lwesitolo oluskalwe nezitoko zokuthenga zazo zonke. Usayizi, izikhala namakhanda ngokwakho: lokhu akuhlolwa nekhodi.

panels.title: Imiklamo yamaphaneli
panels.lead: Khetha izindonga, amaphansi nophahla okuzodwetshwa njengamaphaneli ohlaka. Ngalinye liboniswa yonke i-stud, i-plate, i-header, i-joist noma i-rafter ngesilinganiso, nohlu lokusika. Izilinganiso nesikhala kuyizinani zokuqala ozibekayo, hhayi ukuhlola kwekhodi.
panels.none: Imodeli ayinazindonga, amaphansi noma uphahla oluzohlaka okwamanje. Qala udwebe ezinye.
panels.pick: Khetha okungenani udonga, iphansi noma uphahla olulodwa.

shading.gpu_failed: Ikhadi legrafikhi alikwazanga ukubhaka le mpahla; isithombe sisebenzisa ukubhaka okuhamba kancane kwiprosesa.
shading.delete.text: {name} iyasuswa kulelifayela. Izindawo ezifakwe ngayo zibonisa umbala ozenzakalelayo kuze kuphenduke futhi. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.

shading.panel.name: Igama
shading.panel.averaged: Izithombe eziphezulu zisebenzisa ukulinganisa kwalokhu: {inputs}. Lapho kuphela umbala wesisekelo, ukuqina, insimbi, ukungabonakali, normali nokukhanya okuphumayo ngaphezu komhlaba.
shading.panel.displacement: Ukufuduka kuhambisa amaphoyinti emeshi kuphela (engeza i-Subdivision modifier ukuze uthole imininingwane); ukucindezela nokukhipha izindawo kugcina isimo sazo.
shading.panel.tile: Ithayili eyodwa yoshicilelo imboza {w} × {h} m, ibekwe ngendlela {mapping}.
shading.panel.copy: Yenza ikhophi ehleliseka yempahla eyakhelwe ngaphakathi
shading.panel.how: Impahla iyigrafu yamanodi aphela ngempahla ye-Material output. Ukuthungwa nezibalo kuyizinto zokungenayo; okuphumayo kutshela ukuthi ithayili ingakanani nokuthi ibekwe kanjani.
shading.picture.added: Kungezwe {name}: inodi entsha yesithombe iyasifunda. Xhumanisa umbala wayo nokufakayo.
shading.picture.bad: Lesi sithombe asikwazanga ukufundwa: i-PNG, i-JPEG noma i-WebP, esingadluli ku-16 MB.
shading.lib.unreachable: Umtapo awukwazanga ukufinyelelwa. Hlola uxhumo bese uvula lokhu futhi.
shading.lib.card: {name}: chofoza ukuze uyisebenzise (futhi upende okukhethiwe), noma uyidonse uyilethe phezu kobuso noma eqenjini
shading.lib.drop_miss: Yidonse uyilethe phezu kobuso noma eqenjini.
shading.import.how: Amamephu atholakala ngamagama awo: umbala (albedo, diffuse), ukuqina noma ukukhazimula, ukuba yisinsimbi, okuvamile (OpenGL noma DirectX), ukuphakama (ukunyakaziswa), ukuvinjwa kwe-ambient, ukungaqondakali, ukukhipha.
shading.import.none: Awutholakalanga amamephu okwakheka ngamagama awo (umbala, ukuqina, okuvamile…).
shading.photo.how: Isithombe esisodwa siba impahla ephindwayo: ukukhanya kuyalingana, imiphetho yenziwa ukuthi ihlangane, bese umbala, ukuqina nemephu ejwayelekile kuthathwa esithombeni. Ukuqina kuyalinganiswa: kusethe ngokuya kwendawo. Isithombe esilula, esisquare nesiqondile siyasebenza kangcono.
shading.photo.done: Kwenziwe {name} kusithombe: siyaphindwa njalo: {size} m (ukuhlangana kwakunguma: {before}, manje: {after}; u-1 akubonakali).
shading.photo.bad: Lesi sithombe asikwazanga ukufundwa (i-PNG, i-JPEG noma i-WebP, kuya ku-32 MB).
shading.mx.how: Ukuthumela kubhala izinkomba zalempahla nokwakheka kwayo njengezithombe ze-PNG ngasese kwe-.mtlx (i-zip). Ukungenisa kufunda amafayela .mtlx ngama-shader e-OpenPBR, Standard Surface, UsdPreviewSurface noma glTF PBR; nikeza nezithombe (i-zip noma ifolda): zitholakala ngendlela, ngegama, noma ngegama nohlobo olunye lwesithombe.
shading.mx.mapping_note: Ukubekwa kwebhokisi nokwe-triplanar kubhalwa njengezixhumanisi ze-UV.
shading.mx.no_file: Khetha ifayela le-.mtlx (nezithombe zalo, noma i-zip yakho kokubili).
shading.mx.none: Ifayela: {file} alinampahla enoshader we-OpenPBR, Standard Surface, UsdPreviewSurface noma glTF PBR.
shading.cmd.decal.title: Beka isithombe endaweni engaphezulu njengedekali, nempahla yaso
shading.cmd.texpaint.title: Pendela esithombeni sempahla yobuso ngebhulashi
shading.decal.none: Azikho amadekali okwamanje. Khetha isithombe, bese uchofoza ubuso: siprojektwa phezu kwezindawo ezikulo.
shading.decal.hint: Chofoza ubuso ukuze ubeke idekali khona. Esc iyayeka.
shading.decal.placed: Idekali {name} libekiwe. Impahla yalo isohlwini: yihlele njengezinye.
shading.decal.full: Lo fayela unamadekali amaningi njengoba angabamba (256).
shading.tp.how: Pendela ubuso obugqoka enye yezimpahla zalelifayela: ibhulashi lipenda isithombe esingemuva kombala wesisekelo, ngokuya kwama-UV obuso (ama-mesh) noma ngokudlula ubuso (ezinye izindawo). Impahla enombala oyodwa ithola isithombe esisha esingu-512 × 512 kulowo mbala. Ctrl+Z ihlehlisa umkwapho wokugcina ngesikhathi upenda.
shading.tp.hint: Donsa ubuso ukuze upende isithombe sempahla yabo. Esc iyayeka.
shading.tp.why.no_material: Le nkombandlela ayinampahla yalelifayela. Qala ufake enye yezinto zalelifayela kuyo.
shading.tp.why.library: Izinto zomtapo azikwazi ukupeyintwa. Yenza ikhophi ehlelekayo (iphaneli ye-Shading) bese uyipeyinta.
shading.tp.why.no_uv: Lo mesh awunama-UV okuzopeyintwa kuwo. Qala uwukhulule endaweni yokusebenza ye-UV.
shading.tp.why.mapping: Le mpahla imelwe ngokumapha ngebhokisi noma ngamacala amathathu. Ukupeyinta kudinga ukumapha kwe-UV (Okuphumayo kwempahla › Ukumapha).
shading.tp.why.nodes: Umbala oyisisekelo walempahla uvela kwamanye amanodi. Xhuma inodi yesithombe ku-Umbala oyisisekelo ukuze uyipeyinte.
shading.bake.how: Khetha i-mesh enama-UV (yikhulule endaweni yokusebenza ye-UV). Okujwayelekile, khetha nento yemininingwane ephezulu: leyo enezindandatho ezimbalwa ibhakelwa kuyo. Izithombe zijoyina ifayela; inodi ye-Dirt nokugqoka komphetho yempahla evulekile ithola isithunzi nokugoba.
shading.bake.done: {maps} zibhakiwe, usayizi {size} × {size}, ngesikhathi {s} s. Izithombe zisefayeleni: zikhethe kunodi yesithombe.
shading.bake.wear: Inodi ye-Dirt nokugqoka komphetho yempahla evulekile manje iyazifunda.
shading.bake.failed: Ukubhaka akuqedanga. Zama usayizi wesithombe omncane noma imisebe encane.
shading.bake.why.select: Khetha i-mesh eyodwa ukuze ubhake (noma ezimbili: ephansi nale yemininingwane ephezulu).
shading.bake.why.not_mesh: Ukubhaka kubhala kuma-UV e-mesh. Guqula into ibe yi-mesh bese uyikhulula endaweni yokusebenza ye-UV kuqala.
shading.bake.why.no_uv: Lo mesh awunama-UV. Qala uwukhulule endaweni yokusebenza ye-UV.
shading.bake.why.no_high: Okujwayelekile kudinga into yesibili yemininingwane ephezulu ekhethiwe; ezinye izakhiwo zibhakiwe.

frame.so.note: Ukuhlaziywa okuyisisekelo kwesibili (P-Delta yohlaka, P-delta yendlala ngayinye ehlukaniswe ibe yizingcezu ezingu-{seg}): ukuhlanganiswa ngakunye kuxazululwa ngamandla aso aqondile, hhayi kufakwe ndawonye. Okuyisisekelo, ukuzungeza okuncane, akukho ukwehliswa kokuqina noma imithwalo yokuqagela (akusona ngokwayo indlela ye-AISC direct analysis).
