frame.fem.slab-mitc4: I-shell enamanodi amane, ijiyile noma iphapheme (MITC4)
frame.fem.about: Ixazulula imodeli efanayo ngenjini yezinhlayiya ezingaphelile: amabhimu njengalapha (okukhishwe kwemiphetho kuyagcinwa), amaslabhu nezindonga njengama-shell anamanodi amane, amagumbi aqinile, izisekelo. Ubuningi buyinkomba yobuningi bempahla ngevolumu; imithwalo ayengezi ubuningi. Akuhlolwa kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho ubheka imiphumela.
frame.fem.ran: Amafrikhwensi wemvelo: izindlela ezingu-{n} zitholakele ({dofs} okungaziwa).
frame.fem.err.no-mass: Akukho okunobuningi, ngakho akukho okungunyazayo. Nika impahla ubuningi, bese uphinda.
frame.fem.err.no-dofs: Akukho okukhululekile ukuhamba: wonke amanodi abanjiwe.
frame.fem.warn.not-converged: Amafrikhwensi awazinzanga ezikhathini ezivunyelwe. Thatha aphezulu njengengathembeki.
frame.fem.warn.few-modes: Kukhona izindlela ezingu-{n} kuphela zale modeli.
frame.fem.mass: Ubuningi bezinhlayiya {kg} kg; {dofs} okungaziwa. Izabelo yisisindo semodal esisebenzayo ngakunye kwe-eksisi yomhlaba njengengxenye yobuningi obungahamba (ubuningi bamanodi abanjiwe bushiywe ngaphandle).
frame.fem.title: Amafrikhwensi wemvelo
frame.fem.method: Izinhlayiya ezingaphelile: amabhimu nokuqina kwendlala nobuningi obufanayo, amaslabhu nezindonga njengama-shell amane amancane, amagumbi aqinile endizeni yawo; ukuphindaphinda kwesikhala ngezindlela eziphansi.
frame.fem.limits: Okuyisisekelo, ukunyakaza okuncane. Imithwalo yezindlala nemithwalo esetshenziswayo ayiguqulwa ibe ubuningi. Akukho ukucwasa, akukho inkambo yokuqhuma. Akuhlolwa kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho ubheka imiphumela.
frame.floor.f-value: Ingcindezi kuwo wonke amaslabhu, phansi (kN/m²), kulo mcimbi ongenhla
frame.floor.about: Isebenza kuwo wonke amaslabhu ekhonkithi ahlolwe ukuhlaziya, njengengcindezi phezu kwendawo yawo (imithwalo yesakhiwo nemithwalo yabasebenzisi). Amaslabhu nezindonga zisesihlaziyweni zezinto zekhonkithi kuphela.
frame.floor.no-slabs: Le modeli alinalo ilabhu lekhonkithi ekuhlaziyweni, ngakho ingcindezi ayinamthelela.
frame.ld.not-check: Akuhlolwe kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho ubheka imiphumela.
frame.ld.w.aid: Umoya ebhilidini elivaliwe, eliqinile ngendlela yesistimu eyinhloko yokumelana nomoya (ASCE 7 isahluko 27, izakhiwo zazo zonke izinhlobo): ingcindezi yejubane emgodini ngamunye, ingcindezi yodonga oluphambi nolungemuva, nomthwalo emgodini ngamunye, njengezimo zemithwalo emaslabhini aqinile. Usizo kuze kubhekwe unjiniyela.
frame.ld.w.need-speed: Thayipha isivinini somoya esiyisisekelo V esivela emephini yakho yomoya (izivinini zeRisk Category azikhonjiswa lapha) ukuze ubone imithwalo yomoya.
frame.ld.w.need-run: Qalisa ukuhlaziya (Run) ukuze kwaziwe amagumbi nosayizi wesakhiwo, bese imithwalo yomoya ibonakala lapha.
frame.ld.w.geometry: Ipulani {X} m ngokuya kwe-X, {Y} m ngokuya kwe-Y; ubude bophahla bangu-{h} m ngaphezulu kwezisekelo.
frame.ld.w.summary: Umoya ngokuya {dir}: qh = {qh} kPa, L/B = {LB}, amandla esakhiwo {total} kN.
frame.ld.w.warn-leeward-cp: L/B ingu-{LB}: i-Cp ebhaliwe ngemuva engu−0.5 ivumela L/B kuya ku-1. Amanani wesakhiwo eside kakhulu awakagunyazwa emithonjeni emibili yomphakathi, ngakho kusetshenziswa −0.5 (ohlangothini oluphephile); bhala i-Cp ekhopini yakho yomgomo ebhokisini ukuze uyishintshe.
frame.ld.w.warn-minimum: Umthwalo wodonga oncane ongu-16 psf ulawula emaslabhini amakiwe *.
frame.ld.w.warn-gust-changed: G akusiyo 0.85: kwakhiwa isakhiwo esiqinile kuphela (ifrikhwensi yemvelo 1 Hz noma ngaphezulu); isakhiwo esithambile sidinga inani lesiphepho elivela ohlelweni.
frame.ld.w.warn-roof-below-top: Ukuphakama kophahla oyinikeze kuphansi kwesitezi esiphezulu.
frame.ld.w.note: Indlela yesikhombisi ye-ASCE 7-10 / 7-16, isakhiwo esiqinile (G 0.85), izindonga Cp 0.8 ohlangothini olubhekene nomoya nesi-−0.5 ohlangothini olungabhekene nomoya; ingcindezi yangaphakathi iyaqothuka kwisakhiwo sonke. Umthwalo wesitezi ngasinye yingcindezi phakathi kohhafu wesitezi phezulu nangaphansi, kuwo wonke ububanzi besakhiwo. Ingcindezi yophahla, izimo ezigoqekile, izakhiwo ezigwegwayo, i-ASCE 7-22 nengcindezi yokumboza azakhiwe. Ingxenye yomgomo ngamunye inombolo ivela kuyo, namakhasi awaprinta, ku-"Imithombo". Ijubane lomoya V ngumjikelezo oyisisekelo wesayithi lakho: libhale.
frame.ld.w.made: Yenze amacala omoya angu-{n} (inani eliphezulu lamandla {F} kN). Engeza kuzo ezinhlanganisweni ngokuthi "Yenza izinhlanganisela ze-ASCE 7".
frame.ld.s.aid: I-Ss ne-S1 (kumamephu ekhodi, noma ngokubheka kwe-USGS ngezansi), iklasi lendawo nesistimu yesakhiwo kunikeza i-SDS, SD1, R, Cd no-Ω0 kanye nesipektra yokuphendula yomklamo; "Sebenzisa kwibhulokhi yokuzamazama" ugcwalisa ibhulokhi yokuzamazama ngenhla ngalokho. Usizo kuze kubheke injiniyela.
frame.ld.s.d-exception: Iklasi lendawo D nge-S1 engu-0.2 noma ngaphezulu: khulisa i-SM1 ngo-50 % kunoma yiluphi ukusetshenziswa (isiphakamiso se-ASCE 7-16 11.4.8) esikhundleni socwaningo oluthile lwesayithi
frame.ld.s.usgs-note: Ukubheka kwenziwa ku-inthanethi kuphela lapho ucindezela inkinobho: kuthumela lobu bubanzi, ubude, isigaba sengozi neklasi lendawo kwisevisi yewebhu yemiklamo ye-U.S. Geological Survey (earthquake.usgs.gov/ws/building-codes). Ukubhala i-Ss ne-S1 kusebenza njalo ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
frame.ld.s.result: Fa {Fa} · Fv {Fv} · SMS {SMS} g · SM1 {SM1} g · SDS {SDS} g · SD1 {SD1} g
frame.ld.s.spectrum: Isipektra yokuphendula yomklamo ({kind}): T0 {T0} s, Ts {Ts} s.
frame.ld.s.warn-d-exception: I-SM1 ikhuliswe ngo-50 % (iklasi lendawo D, i-S1 engu-0.2 noma ngaphezulu): sebenzisa i-SD1 etholakele kuwo wonke amabhulokhi.
frame.ld.s.undo-use: Thatha amanani wesayithi uwafake ebhulokhini lokuzamazama
frame.ld.s.used: Ibhulokhi yokuzamazama: SDS {SDS}, SD1 {SD1}, R {R}. Cindezela "Yenza amacala okuzamazama" lapho.
frame.ld.s.err.values: Nikeza i-Ss ne-S1 (noma i-SMS ne-SM1 ye-ASCE 7-22).
frame.ld.s.err.site-class: Khetha iklasi lendawo u-A kuya ku-D. Amaklasi E no-F adinga ucwaningo lwesayithi (akukakhiwa).
frame.ld.s.err.site-specific: Iklasi lendawo D nge-S1 engu-0.2 noma ngaphezulu lidinga ucwaningo lwesayithi (ASCE 7-16 11.4.8): thikha isinqumo se-50 % ngezansi, noma bhala i-SDS ne-SD1 ebhulokhini lokuzamazama.
frame.ld.s.err.latlon: Nikeza ububanzi bomhlaba (−90 kuya ku-90) nobude bomhlaba (−180 kuya ku-180).
frame.ld.s.err.offline: Leli khasi alikwazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Bhala i-Ss ne-S1.
frame.ld.s.err.usgs: Isevisi ye-USGS ayiphendulanga ngamanani. Bhala i-Ss ne-S1 esikhundleni salokho.
frame.ld.c.note: Izinhlanganisela ze-Strength (LRFD, 2.3) noma ze-allowable stress (ASD, 2.4) zamacala e-Dead, Live, ophahla, iqhwa, umoya nokuzamazama, nomphumela wokuzamazama othe xaxa 0.2 SDS D kanye nesici sokweqisa ρ; nezinhlanganisela zokuqina okungaphezulu (Ω0) nazo. Ezi-LRFD zimakwe ukuze kuhlolwe izitho; ezi-ASD nezokuqina okungaphezulu ziyaxazululwa kodwa azihlolwa ngomklamo. Izinhlanganisela iphrojekthi edinga yizo ziyinqubo kaninjiniyela wakho ukuzisetha.
frame.ld.c.no-sds: I-SDS ingu-0: umphumela wokuzamazama othe xaxa awufakiwe.
frame.ld.src.h: Imithombo yomoya, yokuzamazama nezinhlanganisela, nokuthi yini eyashiywa
frame.ld.src.about: Inombolo ngayinye iprintwa okungenani amakhasi amabili azimele wawo (kufundwe ngo-{date}); umgogodla wonke ewodwa awubanjwe. Lapho amakhasi amabili engavumelani noma kutholakala eyodwa kuphela, inani liyashiywa libalwe ngezansi.
frame.ld.err.no-speed: Bhala kuqala ijubane lomoya oyisisekelo V.
frame.ld.err.no-floors: Azikho izitezi okwamanje: cindezela Thola izitezi (noma uzengeze ebhulokhini lokuzamazama), bese uqalisa.
frame.dyn.mass-about: Isisindo kungukuminyana kwempahla kaphindwe ngevolumu, kanye nemithwalo ephansi yamacala angaphansi, ngayinye iphindwe ngesici sayo (isibonelo icala lesisindo esiqinile ku-1 nelicala lokuphila ku-inani oliyithatha njengesisindo). Isisindo secala ngalinye asibalwa kabili. Izici ozibhalayo ziyizinqumo zakho; akukho mthetho wekhodi lapha.
frame.dyn.rs.about: Ukuhlaziya kwesipektra yokuphendula kwemodi kumodeli ye-finite element: izindlela ezitholakele, ngayinye ifundwa esipektrini ngesikhathi sayo, ihlanganiswe nge-CQC noma i-SRSS, bese kuhlanganiswa izinqubo. Inikeza ukunyakaza okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphambuka kwezitezi, amandla ezitho nokusika kwesisekelo. Okuguquguqukayo. Isipektra yakho: ithebula, noma isimo se-ASCE 7 kusuka ku-SDS, SD1 no-TL. Akuhlolwa ngekhodi; ikhaniniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.rs.signs: Amanani ahlanganisiwe awanasimo somqondo: ubukhulu obungenzeka obukhulu kakhulu besenzo ngasinye, hhayi icala lomthwalo. Amandla ezitho yizinqubo zokuphela; ukusika nesigoba akuhlanganiswa ngasendleleni yesitho.
frame.dyn.rs.method: Isipektra yokuphendula yemodi: {m}, izinqumo {rule}, ukunciphisa {xi} % kuyo yonke imodi (isipektra sithathwa njengoba sinikiwe kulokho kunciphisa).
frame.dyn.rs.limits: Okuguquguqukayo. Akukho ukulungisa isisindo esingekho. Ukuphambuka kwezitezi kuguquguqukile akuphindwa ngesici sokukhulisa ukuphambuka, futhi akuhlolwa ngomkhawulo. Izindlela ezinezikhathi ezisondelene ziphathwa yi-CQC, noma ngomthetho wamaphesenti angu-ishumi uma ukhethe. Akuhlolwa ngekhodi; ikhaniniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.sp-asce7: Isimo se-ASCE 7 kusuka ku-SDS, SD1, TL
frame.dyn.sp-rows: Isikhathi (s) nokusheshisa kwesipektra, ipheya eyodwa emugqeni ngamunye
frame.dyn.m-tenpct: Umthetho wamaphesenti angu-ishumi (SRSS, nezindlela ezisondelene zengeziwe)
frame.dyn.th.about: Umlando wesikhathi olinear ngaphansi kokusheshisa komhlaba: ukwengeza kwemodi (imodi ngayinye ixazululwa ngokuqondile kurekhodi elinemigqa ehlukene) noma ukuhlanganisa okuqondile (Newmark average acceleration, Rayleigh damping). Imiphumela iwukuthotha kwesikhathi nomvuthwandaba wengxenye ngayinye. Akuhlolwa ngekhodi; ikhaniniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.th.signs: Imvuthwandaba yamandla ezitho iyinani elikhulu kakhulu lesenzo ngasinye sokuphela phezu kwerekhodi lonke, noma yisiphi isimo.
frame.dyn.th.method: {m}; izinyathelo ezingu-{n} ezingu-{h} s; Newmark average acceleration noma izinyathelo zemodi ezingamanani aqondile; iqala ngokuphumula.
frame.dyn.th.limits: Linear futhi okuguquguqukayo. Iqala ngokuphumula ngaphandle kwesimo sokudonsa. Irekhodi lisetshenziswa njengoba linikiwe: akukho ukuhlunga, ukulungisa isisekelo noma ukulinganisa kusipektra. Akuhlolwa ngekhodi; ikhaniniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.syn-note: Okokufaka okwenziwe: kwakhiwe ukuhlola imodeli, hhayi irekhodi lokuzamazama langempela.
frame.dyn.rec-paste: Noma yisihlanganise: isikhathi nokusheshisa emugqeni ngamunye, noma ukusheshisa okukodwa emugqeni ngamunye nesinyathelo esingenhla
frame.dyn.rec-lost: Lalide kakhulu ukuligcina nemodeli: vula ifayela futhi.
frame.dyn.rec.loaded: Irekhodi lilayishiwe: amaphuzu angu-{n} ku-{dt} s ({saved}).
frame.dyn.rec.session: lide kakhulu ukuligcina nemodeli: ligcinwe kulesi sikhathi kuphela
frame.dyn.rec.err.columns: Umugqa ngamunye udinga inombolo eyodwa (ukusheshisa) noma ezimbili (isikhathi, ukusheshisa).
frame.dyn.rec.err.too-long: Irekhodi linamaphuzu angu-{n}: ngaphezu kwama-200,000 ayenqatshwa.
frame.dyn.rec.err.time-order: Izikhathi kumele zikhule kusuka emugqeni kuya emugqeni.
frame.dyn.rec.err.need-dt: Irekhodi lekholomu eyodwa lidinga isinyathelo sesikhathi esingenhla.
frame.dyn.dm-modal: Imodi: isilinganiso esifanayo kuyo yonke imodi
frame.dyn.direct-note: Ukuhlanganisa okuqondile kusebenzisa i-Rayleigh damping: isilinganiso sifakwa kumodi yokuqala nakowephezulu osetshenzisiwe. Ukunciphisa kwemodi ngezilinganiso ezihlukile ngemodi kuyokwengeza kwemodi.
frame.dyn.ps.about: Okungeyona-linear kwesikhashana: uphahla luphushwa ngokuya ohlangothini ngezinyathelo ezincane; ama-hinge aplastic akha eziphethweni zezitho (okuguquguqukayo, okuplastic ngokuphelele noma okunokuqina, ukuthi amandla e-axial anciphisa umzuzu we-plastic). I-P-delta ingakhethwa. Umphumela: ijika lamandla (ukusika kwesisekelo ngokumelene nokunyakaza kophahla) nezimo ze-hinge. Akuhlolwa ngekhodi; ikhaniniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.ps.stopped.no-convergence: Ukusebenza kuyeke lapha: izibalo zayeka ukuhlangana, ngokuvamile ngemuva kwemishini yokuwa noma ukungazinzi.
frame.dyn.ps.stopped.strength-lost: Ukusebenza kuyeke lapha: ukusika kwesisekelo kwehle kwaba ngaphansi kwesine sesikhulu sayo.
frame.dyn.ps.method: Ama-hinge aplastic aqoqiwe eziphethweni zezitho, ukuqina kwensimbi {fy} MPa, ukuqina {r} % wokuqina kwesiphetho, P-delta {pd}; ukulawula ukunyakaza kophahla; imizuzu epheleleyo ye-plastic ivela kuhlobo lwe-I oludweshiwe (ama-fillet awanakwa).
frame.dyn.ps.limits: Ama-hinge eziphethweni zezitho kuphela (beka i-node lapho kufanele kwakheke i-hinge phakathi kwesipani). Izitho ezingenaluhlobo lwe-I zihlala ziguquguquka. Ukuvuna kwe-axial nokuqina kwezinqamu akumodelwa. Amaslabhu nezindonga zihlala ziguquguquka. Azikho izinqubomgomo zokwamukela ezinikeziwe. Akuhlolwa ngekhodi; ikhaniniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.fy-note: Igreyidi yensimbi yeBlokhi Yomklamo inokuqina kwensimbi okungu-{fy} MPa; yibhale ngenhla ukuze siyisebenzise.
frame.dyn.cap-chart: Ijika lamandla: ukusika kwesisekelo ngokumelene nokunyakaza kophahla
frame.dyn.nl.about: Ama-hinge afanayo ngaphansi kokunyakaza komhlaba nokunciphisa kwebhlokhi yoMlando Wesikhathi (Rayleigh emamodini anikezwe lapho), i-Newmark average acceleration nokuphindaphinda kwe-Newton, iqala esimweni sokudonsa esingenhla. Iyahamba kancane kumamodeli amakhulu: wagcine libe ncane lapha.
frame.dyn.err.no-mass: Akukho okunesisindo. Nika impahla ukuminyana, noma thatha icala lomthwalo njengesisindo ngenhla.
frame.dyn.err.no-dofs: Akukho okukhululekile ukuhamba: wonke amanodi abanjiwe.
frame.dyn.err.no-direction: Zonke izinqumo zivaliwe: nika okungenani eyodwa isikali esingaphezu kwe-0.
frame.dyn.err.no-record: Akukho kokunyakaza komhlaba okuzoqalwa. Khetha okokufaka okwenziwe noma ulayishe irekhodi.
frame.dyn.err.too-many-steps: Lokho kungu-{n} izinyathelo zesikhathi: ngaphezu kuka-200,000 (40,000 ngokusebenza okungeyona-linear). Sebenzisa isinyathelo sesikhathi esikhulu.
frame.dyn.err.bad-damping: Isilinganiso sokunciphisa semodi singaphandle kuka-0 kuya ku-100 %. Hlola izimodi zeRayleigh.
frame.dyn.err.too-big-direct: Ukuhlanganisa okuqondile kukhawulelwe kumamodeli afika kwama-6,000 angaziwa kanye nenani elincane lezinyathelo; sebenzisa ukwengeza kwemodi, noma usebenzise isiteshi sokusebenza.
frame.dyn.err.no-hinges: Akukho sitho esingakha i-hinge: nika izitho uhlobo lwe-I (izinqamu zensimbi ku-Blokhi Yomklamo).
frame.dyn.err.no-floors: Azikho izitezi ezitholakele: ukusunduza kudinga izinga elinamaphoyinti okungenani amabili, noma iflowa eliqinile.
frame.dyn.err.no-control: Isitezi esiphezulu alinaliphoyinti elingasunduzwa ngokuya kuleyo eksisi kuphela.
frame.dyn.err.rec-need-dt: Irekhodi lekholomu eyodwa lidinga isinyathelo sesikhathi.
frame.dyn.warn.mass-short: Ngokuya ku-{dirs} izimodi ezisetshenziswe zithwala u-{pct} % wesisindo kuphela: sebenzisa izimodi eziningi (90 % yinjongo evamile). Okunye kwesisindo akusebenzi emphumeleni.
frame.dyn.warn.zero-sa: Isipektra siyi-0 esikhathini semodi okungenani eyodwa.
frame.dyn.warn.step-coarse: Isinyathelo sesikhathi sikhulu kunesarekhodi: amaphuzu aphakathi kwamasampula ayaphuthelwa.
frame.dyn.warn.direct-rayleigh: Ukuhlanganisa okuqondile kusebenzise i-Rayleigh damping efakwe kwemodi yokuqala nelokugcina esetshenziswe.
frame.dyn.warn.braces: {n} isitho/izitho zikhululiwe eziphethweni zombili noma azikwazi ukwakha i-hinge: ukuvuna nokuqina kwezitho ezinjalo akulingiwe.
frame.dyn.warn.gravity-yield: Ama-hinge sekuvele avune ngaphansi komthwalo wokudonsa ngaphambi kokuqala kokusunduza.
wshape.title: Ukwakheka
wshape.curved: Amathuluzi wokwakheka (ukunamathisela, uhlobo, ukuthambeka, izimbobo) asebenza ezindongeni ezigqamile kuphela.
wshape.slant.deg: amadigri kusuka ekumeni ngqo (+ kuthambekela ngakwesobunxele kwendonga; kabili: ubuso bokhohlo, ubuso bokunene)
wshape.profile.lede: Ukuma kwendonga kubonakala eceleni: umugqa ngamunye uyibanga elikude nendonga kusuka esiqalweni sayo (kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-{len}) nobude ngaphezu kwesisekelo sayo. Shiya umugqa ongezansi ungenalutho uma isisekelo silingene.
wshape.err.curved: Amathuluzi wokwakheka asebenza ezindongeni ezigqamile kuphela.
wshape.err.profile: Iphrofayili idinga amaphoyinti amabili noma ngaphezulu, ngalinye ngobude bendonga, ngokulandelana kusuka esiqalweni sayo.
wshape.err.low: Lowo mumo ushiya ingxenye yodonga ingaphansi kwe-10 mm (noma uphezulu bayo bungaphansi kwesisekelo sayo).
